title: Head of Revenue Optimisation
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Booming Games
description_html:
About the role

This is a new senior individual-contributor role leading Booming Games' revenue optimisation. Reporting to the CCO and acting as the bridge between Business Insight and Commercial, you will own the strategy for maximising revenue across our partners, markets and game portfolio.

You'll set how the business measures commercial performance, decide where effort and investment should go, and make sure data drives decisions across Account Management, Sales, Marketing and Product.

Responsibilities

  • Strategy and leadership: Define and own the revenue optimisation strategy, set the function's priorities and KPIs, and build the processes needed to deliver it, working through Account Management, Sales, Marketing and BI rather than a dedicated team.
  • Senior commercial partner: Act as a key adviser to the CCO and wider leadership team, bringing clear, evidence-based recommendations on growth, risk and prioritisation.
  • Bridge BI and Commercial: Own the relationship with BI, set commercial data requirements and reporting standards, and ensure the commercial team has the insight it needs to act quickly. Champion automation and AI-assisted analysis to speed up insight.
  • Revenue growth across market teams: Work with the Heads of Account Management and Sales to drive GGR growth through lobby placement, game visibility, promotional tools (free rounds, tournaments, network promotions) and release uptake. Build per-partner growth plans and benchmark partners against peers in the same market.
  • Market and launch performance: Oversee performance of new market entries and game launches, setting 30/60/90-day benchmarks and leading corrective action.
  • Forecasting and planning: Assist with revenue forecasting, support budget and target setting across commercial teams, and report performance vs plan to the executive team and board.
  • Promotional and marketing ROI: Partner with Marketing to measure campaign and promotional effectiveness and direct spend to the highest-return activity.
  • Portfolio strategy: Feed performance insight into the product roadmap and game production decisions, shaping which mechanics, themes and features we prioritise by market.

Requirements

  • A strong understanding of commercial strategy and performance management. iGaming experience (B2B supplier, aggregator or operator) is useful but not essential.
  • Deep understanding of iGaming commercial drivers (GGR, bet volume, RTP, retention, game lifecycle, operator merchandising) and how they vary across markets.
  • Strong analytical background with hands-on command of BI tools, preferably Qlik and Power BI.
  • Credible, confident communicator who can influence senior stakeholders internally and at partners, and turn complex data into a clear commercial story.
  • Commercially minded and action-oriented: insight is only valuable when it changes what the team does.
  • How Success is measured
    • Incremental GGR attributable to revenue optimisation initiatives
    • Like-for-like GGR growth across existing partners and markets
    • New market and game launches performing against benchmark
    • Return on promotional and marketing spend
    • Margin across partner commercial agreements
    • Forecast accuracy vs actuals

Good to know

  • We embrace diversity and equal employment opportunities. We are committed to creating a fair, supportive, and open environment for all.
  • Please understand that we can only consider applicants who are located in the European time zone. (+/- 2 hours). All other applications will be automatically deleted due to the high volume of applicants.

Why Work for Booming Games

Founder led. Impact driven. Employee centric.
At Booming Games, we're reshaping the iGaming world with our remote-first approach. Our rhythm? Thrilling slot games with captivating features and stunning designs released every two weeks - no exceptions! Here, it's all about co-ownership and real growth. Dive into a diverse team where your input powers every game we craft!

Our perks

  • We’re a 100% remote-first company, offering a best-in-class remote experience
  • Competitive package
  • Family-friendly policies
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Zestful working environment
  • Knowledge sharing opportunities
  • Dynamic culture surrounded by industry experts
  • Company social events for team bonding

Contact

​HR Team

title: Werkstudent HR – Recruiting & Employer Branding (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ABRIO GmbH
description_html:
Frankfurt am Main · Hybrid · Start ab sofort · 16–20 Stunden pro Woche

Stell dir vor, es ist dein erster Tag als Werkstudent:in HR bei ABRIO. Dein Team empfängt dich herzlich, dein Onboarding ist vorbereitet und beim gemeinsamen Team-Lunch lernst du deine neuen Kolleg:innen kennen. Schon bald hilfst du selbst dabei, weitere Talente für ABRIO zu begeistern.

Als Digital-Commerce-Beratung aus Frankfurt unterstützen wir führende Marken bei ihrem digitalen Wachstum. Im People-&-Culture-Team gestaltest du mit, wie wir passende Menschen gewinnen, neue Kolleg:innen begleiten und unsere Arbeitgebermarke erlebbar machen.

Dabei bringst du dein Wissen aus dem Studium ein, sammelst praktische Erfahrung im Recruiting und Personalmanagement und übernimmst nach deiner Einarbeitung eigene Aufgaben. Regelmäßiges Feedback unterstützt dich dabei, fachlich und persönlich weiterzuwachsen. Klingt spannend? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

DAS ERWARTET DICH

  • Talent Acquisition – passende Menschen finden und begeistern: Du erhältst durch deine Unterstützung im Bewerbermanagement und im Active Sourcing spannende Einblicke in die Welt des Recruitings. Dabei identifizierst du passende Talente und entwickelst kreative Ansprachekonzepte.

  • Talent Management – unsere Kolleg:innen begleiten: Du unterstützt unsere People-Prozesse vom Onboarding bis zum Offboarding. Du hilfst dabei, den Einstieg neuer Kolleg:innen vorzubereiten, Informationen übersichtlich aufzubereiten und organisatorische Abläufe zuverlässig zu gestalten.

  • Employer Branding – ABRIO als Arbeitgeber erlebbar machen: Ob Kampagnen, Mitarbeitenden-Testimonials oder neue Benefits – mit deinem Gespür für starke Ideen lässt du unsere Arbeitgebermarke glänzen.

  • Culture & Feel Good – Zusammenarbeit mitgestalten: Du bist an der Planung und Durchführung von internen und externen Events beteiligt und erstellst Konzepte, die unser Teamgefühl fördern und unsere Arbeitgebermarke stärken.


IT'S A MATCH, SOFERN DU...

  • eingeschrieben bist und dich mindestens im dritten Semester deines Studiums befindest – beispielsweise in BWL mit Schwerpunkt Personal, Personalmanagement, (Wirtschafts-)Psychologie oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • unser Team mit 16–20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen kannst und dich auf die Zusammenarbeit in unserem Frankfurter Büro und im Homeoffice freust.

  • motiviert und lernbereit bist und dich schnell in spannende, verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben einarbeiten möchtest oder idealerweise schon erste Erfahrung in HR, Recruiting oder Employer Branding gesammelt hast.

  • ein Organisationstalent bist, ein Händchen für kreative Recruitingideen hast und du Lust hast, dich mit dem Thema Employer Branding zu beschäftigen und unsere Arbeitgebermarke zu stärken.

  • eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mitbringst und du dich selbst zugänglich und empathisch beschreibst.

  • sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen bist und gerne digital arbeitest.

  • sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse mitbringst.

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Teamspirit, den man erlebt: Offene Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und regelmäßige Teamevents sind bei uns fest verankert. Ob Team-Lunch, Afterwork-Drinks oder gemeinsame Aktivitäten – wir nehmen uns bewusst Zeit füreinander. 

  • Arbeitszeiten, die zu dir passen: Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und abgestimmten Präsenzzeiten gestalten wir gemeinsam eine gute Balance zwischen Studium und Job. 

  • Gestalte mit und wachse in Verantwortung hinein: Bei uns bekommst du die Unterstützung, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, dich weiterzuentwickeln und wertvolle Praxiserfahrung zu sammeln. 

  • Unsere Werte – gelebter Alltag: Teamgeist, Professionalität und Leidenschaft prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, übernehmen Verantwortung und wachsen gemeinsam. 

  • Modernes Büro im Herzen Frankfurts: Unser zentral gelegenes Büro mit moderner Ausstattung bietet dir Raum für kreative Ideen, konzentriertes Arbeiten und entspanntes Abschalten.

Deine Aufgaben

description_html:
Die Gesellschaft für innovative Personalwirtschaftssysteme mbH ist ein führender Softwarehersteller für staatliche, öffentliche und soziale Arbeitgeber in Deutschland. Unser Produkt KIDICAP® ist seit 40 Jahren auf dem Markt und wird heute von rund 25.000 Organisationen als Cloud Service genutzt.

KIDICAP® bildet eine moderne Web-APP-Plattform für alle Bereiche des Human Capital Managements und alle Unternehmensgrößen. Wir beschäftigen rund 200 Mitarbeiter:innen und wachsen weiter.

Zur Verstärkung unserer Entwicklungs-Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine(n):

Java Entwickler (m/w/d)

Arbeitsorte: Remote (Deutschland) oder Offenbach am Main oder Leipzig | Zeitmodell: Vollzeit/ Teilzeit

Teams & Kultur:

  • Die Tech & Produkt Organisation arbietet full remote, besteht aus knapp 160 Mitarbeiter:innen verteilt auf insgesamt ca. 15 crossfunktionale Teams. Diese Teams verantworten aktuell 34 Apps.
  • Wir schätzen Clean Code, eine 'You build it, You run it' Einstellung und trotzdem 'Common Ownership'.
  • Wir arbeiten agil und pragmatisch: JA! Das geht!

Das machst du bei uns:

  • Du entwickelst Komponenten für die Software as a Service Plattform
  • Du arbeitest an thematischen Web-APPs für die Personalwirtschaft
  • Du konzipierst passende Tests und analysierst die Ergebnisse
  • Du planst und beschreibst das Backlog zusammen mit den Product Ownern
  • Du nutzt AI-Tools als festen Bestandteil der Entwicklung von Code, Tests und Reviews

Requirements

  • Du hast eine akademische oder gleichwertige Ausbildung als Informatiker (m/w/d) oder Ingenieur (m/w/d)
  • Du besitzt Erfahrungen in der Entwicklung mit Java bzw. JEE/ Jakarta Enterprise
  • Du verfügst über erste Kenntnisse im Umgang mit JPA Hibernate, CDI, Restful Services und API Design
  • Du hast Erfahrungen mit relationalen Datenbanken, am besten ORACLE DBMS
  • Du konntest bereits Erfahrungen in Test Driven Development und Continuous Integration sammeln
  • Du begeisterst Dich für neue technologische Entwicklungen und willst unsere zukünftige Entwicklung mitgestalten    
  • Du bist offen für AI-gestützte Entwicklung und setzt AI-Tools bewusst und kritisch ein
  • Du hast Freude an Teamwork und Ownership
  • Sprachkenntnisse:Deutsch (C1+)

Benefits

  • New Work: 100% Home Office (innerhalb von D; EU & andere Orte nach Absprache), Flex-Arbeitsplätze an beiden Unternehmensstandorten inkl. Wohnzimmer
  • Persönliches Wachstum: Eine anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit in einer agilen Arbeitsumgebung mit offenen Kommunikationsstrukturen und Spaß an der Arbeit in einem hoch motivierten Team
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Freie Zeiteinteilung und familienfreundliche Kultur
  • Prämien und Boni: Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg
  • Urlaub: 30 Tage + bis zu 12 Zusatztage (Arbeitszeitkonto), Option auf Sabbatical
  • Weiterbildung: Regelmäßige interne oder externe Angebote sowie nach individueller Absprache
  • Vergünstigungen: Pluxee Benefits Card, Corporate Benefits Rabatte
  • Kantine: An den Standorten Leipzig und Offenbach am Main
  • Altersvorsorge: Arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Die GIP ist stolz bei kununu als „Top Company“ ausgezeichnet worden zu sein.

Konnten wir Dein Interesse wecken? Dann sende uns gern Deinen CV über das Online-Bewerbungsformular.

Dein Kontakt

Annika Andresen

(Kooku Recruiting Partners im Auftrag der GIP – Gesellschaft für innovative Personalwirtschaftssysteme mbh)

title: Medical Director (m/w/x)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Doctorflix
description_html:
Role

Als Medical Director verantwortest du den medizinischen Themenkatalog einer der größten CME-Lernplattformen Deutschlands. Was wir zeigen, erreicht unzählige Ärzt:innen – deine inhaltlichen Entscheidungen haben unmittelbaren Einfluss darauf, welches medizinische Wissen in Deutschland ankommt.

Du führst unser siebenköpfiges Medical Team, hältst den Kontakt zu Chefärzt:innen und Meinungsbildner:innen, entwickelst neue Fortbildungsformate mit und baust die Prozesse, mit denen wir vom Startup zum Scale-up werden. Die Rolle ist bewusst breit: strategisch in der Katalog- und Formatentwicklung, operativ im Tagesgeschäft, und immer mit der ärztlichen Perspektive als Maßstab.


Your tasks

  • Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt.

  • Referenten-Netzwerk: Du bist tagtäglich im Austausch mit Chefärzt:innen und KOLs, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und gewinnst daraus kontinuierlich neue Fortbildungsideen.

  • Team-Leadership: Du führst und entwickelst unser Medical Team – zwei Vollzeitkolleg:innen und fünf Studierende. Die Medical Editors arbeiten inhaltlich und stimmen Projekte mit Sponsoren und Referent:innen ab; die Medical Students übernehmen Quality Control, erstellen Kursbeschreibungen und entwickeln neue Themenideen.

  • Formatentwicklung: Wir produzieren Videos, Panel-Diskussionen und E-Learnings – Form und Inhalt greifen ineinander. Bei neuen Formaten wie Kurzvideos oder der Gamification des Lernerlebnisses ist dein medizinischer Input und die ärztliche Perspektive der entscheidende Faktor.

  • Projekt- und Themensteuerung: Du managst die Themenideen laufender Projekte und stimmst dich eng mit Referent:innen ab, damit Projektanforderungen inhaltlich sauber umgesetzt werden.

  • Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Fortbildungen den CME-Standards entsprechen, evidenzbasiert sind und die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen.

  • Prozessverbesserung & Automatisierung: Auf unserem Weg zum Scale-up stehen Automatisierung und schlanke Prozesse im Mittelpunkt. Du streamlinest Workflows und Dokumentationstools im Team und teamübergreifend – als Director bist du dabei die Schlüsselrolle für funktionierende Cross-Department-Zusammenarbeit.


Your profile

  • Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Medizin.

  • Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, gern klinisch, in der Industrie oder in der digitalen Gesundheitsbranche.

  • Führungserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung als Team Lead ist ein klarer Vorteil – entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen entwickeln und Prioritäten setzen kannst.

  • Anpack-Mindset: Wir skalieren. Du regelst Dinge selbst, statt sie nur zu delegieren, und scheust dich nicht davor, auch operativ mit reinzugehen.

  • Begeisterung für Prozesse: Du hast Freude an Projektmanagement, Strukturaufbau und medizinischem Content bzw. medizinischer Lehre – diese Kombination ist der Kern der Rolle.

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in einem Startup sowie in der medizinischen Lehre.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber führenden Mediziner:innen und Industriepartnern, professioneller Kommunikationsstil mündlich und schriftlich.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung.


Why us?

  • Echter Impact: Die Themen, die du verantwortest, erreichen über zig tausende Ärzt:innen. Durch die Verbreitung des neuesten medizinischen Wissens hast du direkten Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität in Deutschland.

  • Mitgestaltung: Du prägst neue Fortbildungsformate und den medizinischen Qualitätsanspruch der Plattform von Grund auf mit.

  • Wachstum & Perspektive: Wir wachsen schnell – entsprechend gibt es echte Aufstiegs- und Gestaltungschancen, die mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen.

  • Ownership: Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und die Freiheit, eigene Ideen umzusetzen.

  • Team: Ein junges, motiviertes und wirklich gutes Team in Prenzlauer Berg. Teamevents, Ausflüge sowie Bier und Wein im Kühlschrank gehören dazu.

title: (Senior) Recruiting Partner (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Yoummday GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

Do you want to make a difference, take ownership and are driven to succeed? That is exactly how we work in our People & Culture team, and we are looking for someone to join us at our Munich headquarters.

As (Senior) Recruiting Partner (m/f/d), you take full ownership of your roles and guide our future Daymakers through the entire recruiting lifecycle across all departments and levels, from entry-level positions to C-level. You combine hands-on recruiting expertise with sound judgment.

Recruiting is at the core of this role. Beyond day-to-day hiring, you contribute focused ideas to improve our selection processes, data foundation and tools. Employer branding is the medium-term development path that we will build together.

Your Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You manage your hiring processes independently across all departments and locations, from the briefing session and channel strategy through screening and interviews to offer close. You use active sourcing selectively where it has the greatest impact for the role.
  • Hiring Manager Partnership & Quality of Hire: You advise hiring managers as an equal partner, including at C-level and VP-level, translate business needs into precise role profiles and challenge expectations constructively. Based on structured interviews, you provide well-founded recommendations for the best professional and personal fit.
  • Funnel, Data & Candidate Journey: You keep your pipeline and our ATS up to date, create an engaging candidate journey and use relevant metrics to provide transparency across your processes.
  • Employer Branding (Your Development Path): You see employer branding as a genuine recruiting lever, are excited to represent our brand on LinkedIn and help us grow this area as your responsibility develops. Previous experience is a plus, but not a requirement.


Your skillset

  • Recruiting Experience & Hands-on Mindset: You have several years of successful full-cycle recruiting experience in a demanding hiring environment, have managed your processes independently and have consistently closed roles.
  • Judgment & Interview Quality: You assess profiles with nuance, conduct structured, competency-based interviews and have a strong sense of who will truly fit the role, the team and our culture.
  • Ownership & Stakeholder Management: You work independently and reliably, make clear decisions and challenge different stakeholders constructively while keeping the shared goal in focus.
  • Communication: You communicate fluently in German and English, with clarity and an approach tailored to your audience, building trust along the way.


Your winning deal

  • Your workplace. You work in a flexible hybrid model from one of our dog-friendly, modern offices - plus up to 2 weeks' workation anywhere in the EU per year (EU passport holders only).
  • The values. An open, authentic culture with a high-performing and genuinely fun team that's already looking forward to making bold decisions with you and finding new paths toward sustainable success.
  • Your footprint. A position at a profitable company where you have the freedom and trust to shape things - and build the future of work alongside us.
  • Your opportunity. From day one, you take ownership, drive innovation, and develop yourself and the company alongside a team of experts.
  • Your benefits. 30 days' vacation, Joblunch subsidy (€69/month), Givve Card (€50/month loaded monthly) or alternatively a subsidised Wellpass membership, discounts via Corporate Benefits, JobRad leasing, company pension contributions (bAV & VL), and outstanding team and company events.

title: Senior Go Engineer, Full Stack
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Topi
description_html:
Your mission

We're looking for product-minded engineers to join our diverse and driven team. We really value collaboration, making an impact, and continuous learning. Our product development team is based in Berlin, but we have folks working all over Europe, and you'll work closely with an experienced and supportive team.


Your profile

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer with deep expertise in Go to join a diverse, product-minded team that values collaboration, impact, and continuous learning. 

We're a distributed engineering team working across Europe (within +/- 1 hour of CET); topi is headquartered in Berlin. Engineers are expected to be comfortable navigating the entire stack (both Frontend and Backend).

In this role, you will be architecting features from the database to the browser. Your center of gravity is the Go backend, APIs, data models, system design, but you'll move into the React/TypeScript frontend whenever the feature requires it. You'll join an experienced and supportive team where you'll have a significant voice in shaping both our technical direction and the product itself.
     About You
This is a role for an engineer who lives in the backend but enjoys reaching across the stack. You'll thrive here if you can:

  • Own the Full Lifecycle: Build, scale, and maintain modern web applications where the heavy lifting sits in our Go backend, with the willingness to ship in React/TypeScript on the frontend whenever a feature calls for it.    
  • Bridge the Gap: Design and implement clean APIs in Go while ensuring they are seamlessly integrated into a performant, accessible React frontend.
  • Architect for Scale: Maintain high standards for code quality and performance across the entire stack, from backend microservices to frontend component libraries.
  • Collaborate Broadly: Work closely with Product and Design to turn ambiguous requirements into polished features.
  • Agentic Engineering Mindset: You treat AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and the like) as real collaborators, not autocomplete. You own every line that ships under your name, whether you typed it or an agent did. You're motivated to deep-dive into agent workflows and bring the judgment that turns agent output into production-grade code.

To Be Successful in This Role, You'll Need:
  • Experience: at least 6+ years of professional software engineering experience in a production environment.
  • The Backend: Proven experience architecting and maintaining high-scale web APIs. You've shipped Go in production for 2+ years and are comfortable owning backend system design end-to-end.
  • The Frontend: Motivated and willing to work in our React/TypeScript frontend, with enough baseline ability to ship features there when a story calls for it. Prior hands-on React/TypeScript experience is a plus, not a must.
  • System Ownership: A "DevOps" mindset, comfortable with CI/CD, automated testing, and version control.
  • Communication: Fluent English and the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
What we care about
  • Teamwork: collaborating and supporting each other within engineering and across functions
  • Inclusion: creating an environment where everybody can bring their whole self and do their best work
  • Ownership: empowering you to do the work that is most impactful
  • Sustainability: balancing work with family and personal hobbies so we can be at our best
  • Growth: supporting each other's learning and development


Why topi?

  • Impact from Day One - Your ideas are valued, and you actively shape our direction. No long feedback loops or complex hierarchies - you'll have a direct impact on what you do.
  • Trust - We believe in our mission and in our team, offering trust-based working hours, permanent contracts, flexibility for home-country working.
  • Flexibility - We offer flexible working hour arrangements to ensure a healthy work-life balance.
  • Team Spirit - Shared rituals connect us, whether online or offline. We have regular formats like all-hands 
  • meetings, demo sessions, quizzes, and offsites - perfect opportunities to spend time as a team.
  • Personal Growth - Learn from experienced colleagues and leverage the latest technologies and methodologies to succeed in your role.

title: Senior Marketing & Communications Manager (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Impossible Founders
description_html:
Your mission

As Senior Communications Manager, you will build and lead marketing and communications initiatives that increase awareness, strengthen our media visibility, and attract the right founders to Impossible Founders’ programs and formats. You will turn our brand and communications priorities into integrated campaigns and audience journeys, taking ownership of day-to-day coordination and execution while working closely with the Director on strategic direction.

  • Own the marketing domain, including performance marketing and analytics, especially for our programs and formats: build audience journeys, funnels, and campaigns across paid, social, and content channels to drive dealflow, participation, and reach; define objectives and KPIs, use data to test and improve results, and make sure campaigns are backed by the right materials (briefs, messaging frameworks, channel plans, landing-page requirements, creative assets, measurement plans).
  • Bring senior judgement on how events, social channels, and content marketing fit together: understanding platform/algorithm mechanics and deciding what materials and assets are needed to run an integrated, proactive marketing system.
  • Lead media relations and PR: proactively identify story opportunities, develop pitches and press materials, prepare spokespeople, and manage relationships with journalists and PR agencies.
  • Support CEO and leadership communications by developing and delivering content and visibility plans in line with the Director's strategic direction.
  • Integrate marketing into program and event planning (with the Event Manager, who owns event operations and delivery) and into CRM/data/automation implementation (with AI & Digital colleagues), so audience journeys and measurement work end to end.
  • Coordinate external agencies, freelancers and internal contributors, providing clear briefs, constructive feedback and quality assurance.
  • Build and maintain a forward-looking campaign calendar and practical workflows/briefing routines that keep priorities visible, flag capacity or timing conflicts, and reduce avoidable last-minute work.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance and integration for the team running content marketing and events, connecting their work into the broader performance and campaign strategy and helping them deliver to agreed priorities and quality standards.
  • Monitor delivery and outcomes, using audience response and performance data to recommend practical improvements.


Your profile

What matters most to us

  • A mix of strategic thinking and a genuine want to operate hands-on: we're all hands-on here, building an exciting, integrated marketing system from the ground up
  • Several years of experience leading integrated communications or marketing projects end-to-end, ideally in a fast-moving startup, agency, or ecosystem environment
  • Hands-on expertise in performance marketing analytics – attribution, funnel/conversion analysis, testing and optimisation frameworks, SEO/AEO, and dashboarding – with the judgement to independently set and defend budget/channel decisions based on the data
  • Proven media relations and PR experience: you've built press relationships, pitched stories, and secured coverage proactively, not just reactively
  • Strong sense of how events, social channels, and content marketing work together – including platform/algorithm dynamics, and what materials are needed to run a joined-up marketing system
  • Experience in project management as well as managing external agencies, freelancers, and multiple internal stakeholders at once
Additionally, it would be a plus if you bring
  • Experience in Deep Tech, venture capital, or startup-ecosystem communications
  • German language skills, useful for local press and stakeholder relations in Hamburg
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM as well as marketing automation tools
  • Event management experience
  • Experience mentoring or informally guiding more junior marketing/comms colleagues (formal line-management experience is not required)


Why us?

At Impossible Founders, the people behind the impossible are the most important catalyst. That's why we do everything we can to create a collaborative working environment:

  • Responsibility & autonomy: You take on real responsibility from day one and have the freedom to actively shape your role and the company. Output counts, and you are given the freedom you need to do your job in the best possible way.
  • Flexible & family-friendly working: We offer a high degree of flexibility through our hybrid work setup. Mondays are our shared office day, while on other days you can choose whether to work remotely or from the office — depending on what works best for your role, team, and personal circumstances.
  • Meaningful mission & impact: You will work on projects that address real challenges in AI, climate tech, and beyond. You will achieve impact and visibility by working closely with founders, researchers, and leading partners.
  • Collaborative culture & diversity: We cultivate a collaborative culture—practical, ego-free, and driven by shared responsibility. Our team is characterized by diversity and openness. The company language is English so that everyone feels welcome.
Attractive working conditions:
  • 30 days of vacation
  • Deutschlandticket
  • International team and English as company language
  • Central office in a prime location
  • Choice of your own hardware

title: Director Venture Scaling - iF Momentum (all genders)

description_html:
Your mission

Breakthrough technologies can create entirely new industries and companies of global relevance – but only if scientific excellence is matched by exceptional execution, capital and commercial ambition. As Director Venture Scaling iF Momentum, your mission is to help build the next generation of DeepTech champions: companies with the potential to become category leaders, scale internationally and transform their industries. You will work side by side with exceptional founders, opening access to industry, capital and talent while developing iF Momentum into a leading European platform for scaling ambitious DeepTech ventures.

  • Take ownership of iF Momentum and its portfolio of highly ambitious DeepTech ventures, helping founders build companies with the potential to become global category leaders while ensuring outstanding program quality, team performance, budget discipline and measurable impact.
  • Identify venture-scale opportunities and challenge founders on the fundamental choices that determine scale: market ambition, positioning, value propositions, business models and commercial strategies and the path towards building a globally competitive company.
  • Turn technological advantage into commercial momentum by helping ventures move from first market validation towards repeatable customer demand, scalable go-to-market models and international growth.
  • Drive commercial and industry scale-up by helping startups develop customer use cases, industrial pilots, venture-client collaborations, licensing models and strategic partnerships – and turn early validation into repeatable commercial traction.
  • Build the financing pathway required for scale – from the next institutional funding round to the capital required for industrialisation and international growth – by challenging financial models, cap tables, equity stories, funding strategies, investor materials and data rooms.
  • Establish clear milestones and priorities for each venture, continuously challenge whether they are on the fastest credible path towards commercial scale, and deploy program resources where they can create the greatest enterprise value and impact.
  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary venture-building team and coordinate closely with colleagues across the wider Impossible Founders platform.
  • Build and activate a high-calibre network of founders, investors, corporates, and experts that can materially accelerate the growth of iF Momentum ventures.
  • Secure new sponsorships, strategic partnerships and commercial opportunities, and develop scalable business models and future revenue streams for iF Momentum.


Your profile

What matters most to us

  • You know what separates a promising technology from a venture-scale company and have the judgement to identify opportunities with the potential to build significant, globally competitive businesses.
  • You bring substantial professional experience from venture capital, entrepreneurship, venture building, transaction or strategy advisory, venture building, or a fast-growing technology company – ideally with direct exposure to building, financing or scaling ambitious technology ventures.
  • You fully understand the specific challenges of DeepTech commercialisation and can bridge the worlds of science, technology, industry and capital.
  • You have worked closely with ambitious founders through critical stages of company building – ideally including commercial scale-up, institutional fundraising, international expansion or the creation of a new market category.
  • You are confident working with business plans, financial models, cap tables, market and competitive analyses, due diligence materials and investor narratives.
  • You have successfully supported startups turn commercial strategy into traction – developing customers, industry partnerships, pilots and go-to-market models that can ultimately scale beyond individual projects.
  • You combine strategic judgement with a hands-on mindset and are comfortable challenging founders on ambition, priorities, milestones and difficult decisions.
  • You can already bring in an established network of investors, industry partners, and senior operators and know how to activate it when it can materially accelerate a venture.
  • You have experience leading teams, projects or portfolios and know how to create clear responsibilities, high quality standards and an effective delivery culture.
  • You communicate clearly and credibly with founders, executives, investors, scientists and external partners in an international environment.
  • You are fluent in English; German language skills are highly desirable.
Additionally, it would be a plus if you bring
  • Practical exposure to patents, intellectual property strategies, licensing processes or technology transfer.
  • Experience with industrial pilots, venture-client models, joint development agreements or other forms of startup–industry collaboration, or experience scaling your own startup.
  • Exposure to public grants, non-dilutive funding or blended financing strategies.


Why us?

At Impossible Founders, the people behind the impossible are the most important catalyst. That's why we do everything we can to create a collaborative working environment:

  • Responsibility & autonomy: You take on real responsibility from day one and have the freedom to actively shape your role and the company. Output counts, and you are given the freedom you need to do your job in the best possible way.

Mondays are our shared office day, while on other days you can choose whether to work remotely or from the office — depending on what works best for your role, team, and personal circumstances.

  • Collaborative culture & diversity: We cultivate a collaborative culture - practical, ego-free, and driven by shared responsibility. Our team is characterized by diversity and openness. The company language is English so that everyone feels welcome.

  • Central office in a prime location

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (mf/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at SR Security Research Labs - Personio
description_html:
About us:

Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/f/d) | Elternzeitvertretung / Parental Leave Cover
Fixed-term, around12 months  |  ideally part-time (60–80%), with the option to extend to full-time  |  Berlin (hybrid)  |  Recruiting for SRLabs and Allurity group companies
based candidates.

Please apply only if you are based in Berlin and has right to work. No visa sponsor available, No remote options available.

About us
SRLabs is home to some of the sharpest minds in cybersecurity. We secure critical infrastructures in finance, energy, and telecommunications — not through compliance checklists, but through hands-on hacking resilience. Our work lives at the intersection of deep technical research and impactful consulting for organisations that care about staying ahead of real threats.
We're a team of 60 people based in Berlin, with colleagues from all over the world. We're part of Allurity, a European cybersecurity group of 12+ sister companies, which gives us scale without sacrificing our startup energy.

We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to cover a parental leave for around 12 months. In this role, you won't just recruit for SRLabs — you'll also support hiring across several of our Allurity sister companies, working closely with our cross-company People Hub. It's a great opportunity to get hands-on, end-to-end recruiting experience across a range of technical and business roles, in an organisation that takes hiring seriously without drowning it in process.


Your responsibilities

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own end-to-end recruiting for open roles at SRLabs and selected Allurity sister companies — from intake call to signed offer.
  • Write and post compelling, accurate job ads that speak to the kind of people we want to attract.
  • Screen applications and conduct first-round interviews, giving candidates a fair, fast, and human process.
  • Coordinate interview loops with hiring managers and technical interviewers, and keep candidates informed at every step.
Sourcing
  • Proactively source candidates for harder-to-fill and technical roles via LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and other channels.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring role types across the group.
  • Help identify and test new sourcing channels, particularly for niche cybersecurity talent.
Cross-Company Collaboration
  • Partner with hiring managers and People colleagues across Allurity sister companies to understand their hiring needs and local market context.
  • Contribute to shared recruiting standards, templates, and best practices via the People Hub.
  • Support group-wide initiatives such as the graduate/internship pilot and employer-branding activities where relevant.
Candidate & Hiring Manager Experience
  • Be the main point of contact for candidates throughout the process — approachable, responsive, and clear.
  • Coach hiring managers on structured interviewing and help them make confident, fair decisions.
  • Gather feedback to continuously improve the candidate and hiring manager experience.
Systems & Process
  • Keep our ATS/Personio data accurate and up to date — job postings, pipelines, candidate statuses, and reporting.
  • Maintain recruiting-related documentation and help keep our hiring process easy to follow for everyone involved.
  • Track basic recruiting metrics (time-to-fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness) and flag bottlenecks early.


What do you bring?

  • Proven technical recruiting experience (agency or in-house) — this is a must. You've hired engineers, security specialists, or comparable technical profiles, and you can hold a credible conversation with them. This isn't a role for a first-time recruiter, but you don't need to be senior either.
  • A bit of hands-on sourcing know-how — comfortable using LinkedIn Recruiter or similar tools, and not afraid of a Boolean search string.
  • Good communication skills in both German and English — you can run a candidate conversation and write a clear job ad in either.
  • A structured, organised way of working — you keep pipelines tidy and don't let candidates fall through the cracks.
  • Genuine affinity for tech and cybersecurity talent — you don't need to code yourself, but you understand technical roles well enough to assess and engage the people in them.
  • Comfortable working across multiple companies and stakeholders at once, with a good sense for adapting your approach to different teams and cultures.
  • Ownership mentality — you follow through, flag issues early, and don't wait to be told what's next.
  • Based in Berlin, with an existing right to work in Germany.


What awaits you with us?

  • A front-row seat in the world of cybersecurity — one of the most interesting and relevant fields there is right now.
  • Real end-to-end ownership of recruiting across multiple companies, not just req-filling.
  • A close-knit, international team that takes the work seriously but doesn't take itself too seriously.
  • 30 days of paid vacation (pro-rated for the contract term).
  • Learning budget for courses or conferences relevant to your role.
  • BVG public transport pass and gym membership discounts.
  • German language lessons (if you need them).
  • Flexible home office.
  • Exposure to group-wide People initiatives and colleagues across 12+ Allurity sister companies.
 
This is a fixed-term position (Elternzeitvertretung) for approximately 12 months, covering a parental leave. It starts as a part-time role at 60–80%, with the option to move to full-time during the contract term depending on hiring volume. There's a real possibility of a handover period with the current role holder to ensure continuity.


Apply now

SRLabs is committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on any basis — we welcome applications from all qualified individuals.

Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you.

description_html:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a (Senior) Sustainability Manager in our Product Management team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our Sustainability Cockpit. Working at the intersection of product, regulation, and customer needs, you will drive the continued development of solutions supporting organisations in meeting evolving sustainability reporting requirements.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to translate regulatory developments and customer feedback into valuable product capabilities. If you enjoy combining sustainability expertise with product thinking and want to help customers navigate an evolving ESG landscape, we'd love to hear from you.

EQS Group is a leading international cloud software provider in the areas of Compliance & Ethics, Data Privacy, Sustainability Management, and Investor Relations. We help thousands of companies worldwide to cultivate trust by simplifying complex processes, ensuring transparency, and enabling clear communication with stakeholders.

Our success is built on our people. We bring together talented individuals who care about doing meaningful work, take pride in what they do, and support one another to achieve more together. We believe passion and trust aren’t just values — they’re at the core of how we operate, every day.

Be part of an exciting journey and contribute to our success story of becoming the leading provider of digital compliance and governance solutions.


THIS IS YOU

  • Experience supporting customer conversations, product demonstrations, or go-to-market initiatives.
Nice to have
  • Familiarity with agile product development methodologies.

We are open to hiring remotely in Germany.

title: Working Student – Talent & Operations
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Apheris
description_html:
About Apheris

At Apheris, we are building the future of how AI is applied in pharmaceutical R&D. We enable leading pharmaceutical teams to discover and develop drugs faster. We host the industry’s largest federated data networks for drug discovery AI, spanning co-folding, ADMET, and antibody developability. 

Across these networks, models are trained on proprietary industry datasets to achieve higher performance and broader applicability while keeping data control and IP protected. We deliver these superior models through drug discovery applications that enable teams to run them at scale, further customize them, and integrate them into existing R&D workflows. 

  • AI Structural Biology (AISB) Network: Pharmaceutical companies collaborate in the field of co-folding, structure-based binding affinity predictions and antibody design.
  • ADMET Network: Pharmaceutical and biotech companies collaborate to improve small-molecule property prediction and expand into further drug modalities.
  • Antibody Developability Network: Pharma partners collaborate to federate historical and purpose-built antibody developability data sets for secure ML training, without data leaving each partner’s environment.


About the role

As our Working Student – Talent and Operations, you will support the People, Operations & Talent Acquisition functions. You will be based in our Berlin office, working alongside our People Operations team on in-person office tasks. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes structure, keeps things moving, and wants a close look at how People & Operations works in a fast-growing AI company while working closely with cross-functional teams in an international environment.


What you will do

Talent Acquisition support 

  • Process inbound applications in our ATS (Personio) and keep candidate records clean and up to date
  • Coordinate the candidate journey end-to-end, ensuring timely interview scheduling and clear communication on next steps to maintain a smooth and positive candidate experience
  • Manage the careers inbox and respond to candidate questions
Operations support
  • Support logistics for team events and offsites
  • Support the reorganization of our SharePoint drive so documents are easy to find
  • Help bring our sustainability and CO₂ reporting up to date
HR support
  • Pick up tasks on ongoing People and company projects
  • Help coordinate onboarding emails and pre-start communication for new joiners
  • Document processes as you go so they are easy to hand over


What we expect from you

  • Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's programme in HR, Business, Psychology, Communications or a related field
  • Prior experience in HR, recruiting, office management or operations (e.g. an internship or previous working student role)
  • Based in Berlin and able to work from our office on a regular basis
  • Very organized, reliable and detail-oriented; you follow things through without being chased
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office (Excel, SharePoint, Outlook); experience with Personio is a plus
  • Clear, friendly written and spoken communication in English; German is a plus
  • Discretion when handling confidential candidate and employee information
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for working with AI tools matter more than prior AI experience


What we offer you

  • Flexible working hours that fit around your studies (20 hours per week), with a flexible hybrid setup including two days per week in the office.
  • Real ownership of tasks from day one and close collaboration with the People & Operations team (Shaked, Erin and Joe)
  • Plenty of room to grow personally and professionally and shape your own role 
  • A modern office in Berlin, monthly happy-hours, and social allowance
  • Strong learning and development opportunities in a fast-growing AI company
  • Office Days at our Berlin HQ or a different European location (3x a year)


Logistics

  • Initial Screening: If your application matches our requirements, we invite you to an initial video call to explore the fit. In this 30-45-minute interview, you will get to know us and the role. The interviewer will be interested in your relevant experiences and skills, as well as answering any questions on the company and the role itself that you may have.
  • Deep Dive: In this phase, the people team will assess your skills and knowledge required for the role by asking you about meaningful experiences or your solutions for specific scenarios in line with the role we are staffing.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (m/f/d) in Berlin or Konstanz
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at KNIME AG
description_html:
Mission

Join KNIME in developing a state-of-the-art end-to-end AI and data science platform that helps thousands of professionals around the world to answer their data questions via one of the most reliable and transparent computation frameworks – KNIME workflows.


Role Overview

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer in the user-facing Sleek UX team, you will provide meaningful contributions to enhance the day-to-day experience of the people who build with KNIME. Together with a team of outstanding engineers, you will be involved in designing and implementing cross-stack features within KNIME’s family of products, written in Java and Vue. You will be working closely together with our product managers and designers to make the user experience frictionless, enjoyable, and consistent.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain end-to-end features that provide value to the many people building their data workflows with KNIME.

  • Design and implement robust backend business logic to ensure reliable application performance.

  • Partner with stakeholders to translate product requirements into intuitive user experiences.

  • Leverage AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development workflows while maintaining strict engineering standards.

  • Uphold code quality through automated testing, peer reviews, and continuous delivery pipelines.

  • Track usage of AI agents within daily development routines to ensure they are deployed for suitable tasks with proper oversight.


Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in professional software development.

  • High competence in frontend development (Vue, React, or similar).

  • High competence in backend development (Java and modern Java frameworks).

  • Experience in contributing to the architecture of existing software systems.

  • Experience with AI-assisted software engineering (experience with AI agents is a plus).

  • Ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases.

  • Solid understanding of full stack development.

  • Practical experience with Golang is a plus.

  • Fluent in English (both verbal and in writing).


Leveling

You will be a Full-Stack Software Engineer in the Sleek UX team, reporting to the team lead, with ample opportunity for career and personal growth with KNIME’s comprehensive levelling framework.


What Success Looks Like

  • Contribute ideas and technical insight to team discussions and code reviews.

  • Surface and mitigate technical debt, security issues, and architectural risks.

  • Grow knowledge and experience measurably by navigating technical challenges and enhancing user value.

  • Add to a healthy, collaborative environment where trust enables a genuine sense of enjoyment and pride in building great software together


What we offer

  • Ownership across the stack: Own features end to end across Java, TypeScript influencing architecture and direction.

  • An exceptional team to work with: highly capable, independent engineers who are a pleasure to work with.

  • Visible impact: Help shape an intuitive experience that thousands of data professionals around the world rely on every day.

  • Deep collaboration in a low-ego, global culture: Work closely with fellow engineers, architects, QA, and UX in an open environment spanning more than 30 nationalities that values transparency, low-ego collaboration.

  • Continuous learning: Hands-on challenges, peer exchange, soft-skill training and learning cafés, and exposure to cutting-edge AI and data-analytics work.

  • Flexibility, health and wellbeing: Hybrid working, flexible hours, subsidised sports or yoga courses, physiotherapy, and flu shots at select locations.

  • Great places to work: Beautiful offices, including one in the heart of Berlin Kreuzberg, along with the everyday things that make office days good: shared breakfasts and lunches, a stocked fruit basket, and celebrations.

description_html:
Über uns:

In der Welt des IT-Handels gehen wir neue Wege: Das größte Sortiment, persönliche Beratung und tiefgehende Lösungskompetenz – aus einer Hand. 
Wir arbeiten mit über 300 Mitarbeitenden deutschlandweit und mit einem der größten Onlineshops in Deutschland. Unser umfassendes Hersteller-Portfolio und unsere gebündelte Fachexpertise stellen dabei sicher, dass wir immer die richtige Lösung für individuelle Anforderungen bieten können.
 
Seit der Gründung im Jahr 1990 ist JACOB weit gekommen: Im Laufe der Jahrzehnte haben wir uns von einem regionalen Ladengeschäft in Karlsruhe zu einem bedeutenden IT-Dienstleister für Unternehmen entwickelt. Unser fester Wille, immer wieder innovative Ansätze zu suchen, hat diese Entwicklung erst ermöglicht.
 
Und diese Kreativität, gepaart mit Fachkompetenz, nehmen wir in die Zukunft mit. Wir möchten uns weiterentwickeln und dabei beibehalten, was uns ausmacht. Gehst du diesen Weg mit uns?


Wir suchen:

Das Team IT Infrastructure der JACOB Elektronik GmbH sucht Verstärkung!
Für den Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Linux-basierten IT-Infrastruktur suchen wir dich als
Senior Systems Engineer Linux (m/w/d)
in Vollzeit (40h/Woche). Bei JACOB übernimmst du die Verantwortung für unsere Systemarchitektur, betreibst und optimierst komplexe Infrastrukturen und integrierst moderne Technologien wie Container- und Orchestrierungslösungen. Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklungsteams zusammen, bringst deine Expertise in technische Entscheidungen ein und treibst die Qualität sowie Zukunftsfähigkeit unserer IT-Landschaft aktiv voran.


Deine Aufgaben:

Aktuell bei uns im Fokus:

  • Betrieb unserer on-prem Kubernetes Cluster und Vereinheitlichung unserer on-prem und AWS Kubernetes-Landschaft
  • Teilweise Migration von AWS Workloads nach on-prem
  • Optimierung unserer Datenbankserverumgebung
  • Aufbau einer Proxmox oder Incus on-prem-Umgebung
  • Einführung von Ceph
  • Optimierung unserer Logging-Umgebung
Unsere Aufgaben:
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung einer nachhaltigen Zielarchitektur sowie Umsetzung technischer Lösungen
  • Betrieb, Administration und Wartung der verantworteten Infrastruktur inkl. Beratung und Support für Entwicklerteams in Projekten
  • Durchführung von Evaluationen und Proof of Concepts sowie nahtlose Integration neuer Systeme und Technologien in die bestehende Infrastruktur
  • Erstellung und Review von Konzepten, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Dokumentationen
  • Kontinuierliches Vorantreiben von Infrastrukturqualität und technischer Weiterentwicklung
  • Planung technischer Tasks und transparente Fortschrittskommunikation


Dein Profil:

Was dich besonders macht:

  • Du magst die Monty-Python-Werke und bist dahingehend empfänglich für Anspielungen und Witze
  • Deine Techpriester-Weihe erlaubt es dir, auch anspruchsvolle Maschinengeister zu besänftigen
  • Lachsschnittchen zu einem Namensschema-Meeting klingt für dich absolut plausibel
  • Technisches Fachsimpeln ist für dich einfach eine Art von Smalltalk
  • Du bist ein Fan von Ritualen und ein fester Dönerstag (auch fleischlos) wäre dir willkommen
  • Humor erachtest du als eine äußerst wichtige Kompetenz und ein angenehmes Arbeitsklima steht bei dir an oberster Stelle
  • Du behandelst andere freundlich und respektvoll, und möchtest auch selbst so behandelt werden
  • Am liebsten bist du im Büro, weil es vor Ort mit den Kollegen am schönsten ist
  • Deine Deutschkenntnisse erlauben es dir auch auf der kommunikativen Ebene sicher zu deeskalieren und ein Führerschein der Klasse B, ins 200m entfernte Rechenzentrum zu fahren
  • Du genießt es, Handlungsspielraum zu haben und auch neue Technologien auszuprobieren und einzuführen
  • Du bringst viel Erfahrung im Bereich Linux Server/Services, Netzwerk und aus unserem Tech Stack mit

Unser Tech Stack:
Git <3, Debian GNU/Linux, SaltStack, Terraform, Nutanix, Proxmox/Incus, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, RabbitMQ, Icinga, Prometheus, HAProxy, nginx, Apache, nftables, FreeRADIUS, Docker, Kubernetes, Gitlab, AWS (EKS, ECS, Cloudfront, RDS, ...)


Wir bieten:

Bei JACOB erwartet dich ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, das dir Freiraum für eigene Ideen und neue Herausforderungen bietet. Das heißt konkret:

  • Du profitierst von unseren Benefits: Mitarbeiterrabatt auf unser riesiges Produktsortiment, JobRad, Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Arbeitsplatzbrille, Ticket-Restaurant, Freie Getränke (wie Kaffee, verschiedene Teesorten, Cola, Fanta, Sprite, verschiedene Sprudelsorten wie Orangen- und Multivitamin-Sprudel und natürlich auch Wasser in verschiedenen Varianten)
  • Klar, dass du modernes IT-Equipment zum Arbeiten erhältst 
  • Wir bieten ein hybrides Modell für mobile Arbeit 
  • Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten und Raum für Ideen 
  • Unser People Development hilft dir, dich in deiner Rolle und als Persönlichkeit weiterzuentwickeln 
  • Das DU gehört zu uns: Von Anfang an - beim Bewerbungsgespräch bis zum Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung 
  • Kaltes Wasser? - Gibt's bei uns nicht. Du wirst top vorbereitet und von deinen Kolleg:innen intensiv in deinen abwechslungsreichen und spannenden Aufgabenbereich eingearbeitet
Bei JACOB steht der Mensch im Fokus. In unseren Entwicklungsteams sind die vielfältigsten Erfahrungen und Charaktere vertreten – und davon suchen wir noch mehr! Diversität spielt für uns eine wichtige Rolle.


Interessiert?

Falls dich das anspricht, sende uns deine Bewerbung (Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse) unter Angabe deines Gehaltswunsches und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins bitte nicht per RFC1149, sondern per E-Mail an Ervin Kurtic von People & Talent unter Tel. 0721/94176-2700 gerne zur Verfügung.

title: Senior Product Manager (all gender)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kranus Health Gmbh
description_html:
Job description

Who we are 
Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Kranus Health is a digital therapeutics platform running in several countries across urology and gynecology. Our newest therapy, Kranus Mictera, treats urinary incontinence in women, a condition that affects one in three women and that almost no onetakes seriously. Our therapies are built together with leading clinicians and scientists, prescribed by doctors, and reimbursed by health insurers, whichmeans everything you ship reaches patients with a real diagnosis instead of a wellness audience. We are ~50 people, everyone here owns outcomes ratherthan tickets, and AI is a settled part of how we work, so you won't be stuck in 2022 tooling here. One platform, many therapies, 3 countries. Small team. Big impact. If you live and breathe change, you will feel at home here.

The Role
As our Product Manager in charge of our consumer-facing Digital Therapeutics, you will lead the way to transform our platform of therapies from good to first-class with taste. This is not a feature-shipping role. We want someone who thinks in user journeys, obsesses over behavior change, and can tell the difference between a product that works and one that genuinely moves patients forward.

Your responsibilities

  • Therapy ownership: You own the full patient journey end-to-end – from the moment a doctor prescribes the therapy, through onboarding and the active therapy phase, to the point where patients feel a real difference and stay. AI is part of the work and part of the product – but it's a means to an end, not the goal itself. 
  • Behavior & retention: You apply proven knowledge of habit loops, nudges, feedback systems, and engagement mechanics to drive sustainable usage. 
  • Mobile ownership: You own our therapy apps across urology and gynecology end-to-end. 
  • App Store excellence: You treat ratings, store presence, and ASO as core product levers, and actively optimize the funnel from impression to activation.


YOUR TOOLKIT

  • Mobile expertise: Hands-on product management experience with consumer mobile apps. 
  • Platform fluency: You understand the technical realities of iOS and Android and know how to work with them – not around them. 
  • Data & AI fluency: You use AI to move fast, know when it's hallucinating, and back every decision with analytics and experiments, because you own the outcome.
  •  Languages: Fluent in German and English. 
  • High agency: You naturally push topics forward, bring people along, and don't wait to be asked. 
  • Taste: You know what a great, beautiful, yet functional product needs to look like in 2026. 
  • Optional – health or behavior background: Experience building patient-centric or behavior-change products, or genuine passion for it.


OUR SUPPORT AND YOUR BENEFITS

  • Trust - We believe in the talent we hire. You will receive a permanent contract. Home office is easily possible with us.
  • Body & Mind - You get an "Urban Sports Club" membership and your own leased bicycle at your free disposal.
  • Future - We support your company pension scheme and will be happy to explain the benefits to you.
  • Impact - work with meaning? Together with you we improve the health care of patients, every day.

CONTACT

title: Senior Engineering Project Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Idealworks
description_html:
The Role: What to expect

Idealworks builds industrial automation as a coordinated system — mobile robots, orchestration software, simulation, and increasingly humanoids and physical AI, working together in real production environments rather than as isolated pilots. Since our founding within BMW Group and our integration into Agile Robots SE, we've grown from a Munich-based robotics team into a global player.

As physical AI and humanoid robotics move from research into industrial deployment, our project landscape is expanding: today's programs span classic mobile robot fleets, next-generation humanoid platforms, and the simulation environments used to develop and validate both. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Project Manager to lead this kind of work end to end - technically credible enough to sit with R&D and hardware/software engineering, and organized enough to keep shareholders, partners, and customers aligned as programs move from concept to production.


Role Responsibilities: What you will do

Project & Program Delivery

  • Manage complex engineering projects across the full lifecycle — from scoping and planning through execution, integration, testing, and handover — spanning both software and hardware workstreams.
  • Define and manage project plans, milestones, budgets, and resourcing; monitor schedule, cost, quality, and contractual compliance throughout.
  • Identify technical, schedule, and commercial risks early, and drive mitigation and contingency planning across multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Plan and coordinate integration and validation phases (e.g., factory and site acceptance testing) across hardware, software, and systems components.

Cross-Functional & Technical Coordination
  • Act as the connective layer between product management, partner management, solution engineering, software development, hardware development, R&D, innovation management, and operations — ensuring each function's inputs and dependencies are captured and sequenced correctly.
  • Work closely with engineering leads on cutting-edge developments in mobile robots, humanoid platforms, simulation tooling, and physical AI to translate technical realities into realistic, defensible project plans.
  • Support innovation and R&D initiatives as they mature into deployable projects, helping bridge the gap between exploratory work and production-grade delivery.

Stakeholder & Partner Management
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for a diverse stakeholder landscape, including shareholders, technology and integration partners, and customers, tailoring communication to each audience.
  • Prepare and lead steering committee meetings, status reviews, and escalation discussions; ensure decisions are documented and followed through.
  • Manage claims, change requests, and contract or scope amendments in coordination with commercial and legal stakeholders.
  • Build long-term, trust-based relationships with partners and customers that extend beyond a single project milestone.

Operational Excellence
  • Track and report on project and portfolio KPIs (schedule adherence, cost/margin, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction) to leadership and shareholders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of project management methodology, tooling, and best practices across the organization.
  • Support resource planning and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent engineering projects.


Role Requirements: What you need to succeed

  • At least 5 years of experience in a similar role, or in a technical role such as engineering, software development, product management, program management, project management, or partner management, within the robotics industry or a domain of comparable technical complexity (e.g., autonomous systems, industrial automation, advanced hardware/software integration).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional engineering projects that combine hardware and software development.
  • Strong technical fluency to engage credibly with R&D, software, and hardware engineers on cutting-edge topics in mobile robotics, humanoids, simulation, or physical AI, without needing to be the domain expert yourself.
  • A track record of managing external stakeholders e.g. customers, partners, or investors including steering committees, escalations, and commercial discussions.
  • Solid grounding in project management fundamentals: planning, budgeting, risk management, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and business/executive audiences.
  • A degree in engineering, computer science, software development, mechatronics, robotics, or a related technical field is a plus.
  • Fluency in English required; German is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as project needs require.


Why idealworks

  • At idealworks, you will find an international working environment and become part of an experienced, open team where mutual trust counts. You will feel at home from the very first second!
  • Experience a first-hand start-up feeling and flat hierarchies with varied and responsible tasks that you work on independently.
  • Look forward to hybrid working model with 30 vacation days per year and various opportunities to balance your free time, family and job.
  • For your commitment to helping us achieve our mission, you will not only be rewarded with appreciation, but also with above-average pay including a bonus scheme and an annual personal development budget.
  • We offer exciting corporate benefits, an attractive company pension scheme and regular team events.
  • Our modern office is easily accessible by public transport, bike and car and offers numerous catering options for relaxed lunch breaks with your team.
  • Driven by our unique corporate culture, the five values "passion for results", "wellbeing", "personal growth", "trust" and "being and acting as one team" determine our daily actions and cooperation.

description_html:
Mobileye is looking for a highly experienced and technically outstanding Senior Technical Lead to drive strategic technical leadership across hardware architecture, safety, system-level decision making, and cross-organizational execution. This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who can operate at both the detailed engineering level and the broader system and organizational level, while also driving practical innovation in areas such as AI-enabled workflows and robust industrialization.


What will your job look like:
  • Provide technical leadership in Mobileye Robotaxi initiative and move the organization toward industrialization of Mobileye L4 platforms.
  • Serve as a key technical authority for hardware architecture, system-level thinking, and cross-domain technical alignment.
  • Shape the technical direction of the group by contributing to long-term strategy, identifying risks, and influencing architectural decisions.
  • Lead critical investigations and technical deep-dives, bringing clarity, structure, and strong judgment to complex topics.
  • Guide and challenge internal and external stakeholders with confidence, ensuring ownership boundaries are clear and responsibilities remain well defined.
  • Own and drive HW engineering work packages with exceptional technical rigor, ensuring high-quality execution even in resource-constrained environments.
  • Support the development of robust industrialization flows and practical AI-based implementations that improve execution, efficiency, and technical quality.
  • Mentor team members, including supporting transitions into management roles and strengthening team capability.
  • Act as a trusted partner across Mobileye, building alignment, resolving ambiguity, and fostering effective collaboration with internal teams, customers, and suppliers.
  • Maintain exceptionally high standards in engineering quality, professionalism, and ownership.

    • All you need is:
  • 10+ years of experience in hardware engineering, system architecture, or a related technical leadership role.
  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to combine strategic thinking and practical execution.
  • Proven experience leading HW design or similarly critical technical domains with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Deep understanding of hardware architecture, system-level tradeoffs, and cross-functional technical integration.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams, functions, and organizational boundaries.
  • Strong leadership skills with a track record of mentoring, developing, and enabling engineers and future leaders.
  • Ability to make clear technical decisions, establish priorities, and push back constructively when needed.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills in complex internal and external environments.
  • Interest or experience in applying AI to engineering workflows, industrialization, or technical productivity improvements.

description_html:
Übernimm Projektverantwortung und gestalte mit uns die IT von morgen!

Du suchst eine neue berufliche Herausforderung als IT-Systemadministrator / IT-Techniker (m/w/d) in der IT-Branche? Dann verstärke schon bald unser Team in Göttingen, Braunschweig und Hannover!

Bei uns erwartet dich ein vielfältiges Aufgabengebiet, bei dem du Verantwortung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von IT-Infrastrukturprojekten bei unseren Kunden übernehmen kannst. Dabei ist es dir auch wichtig, dich einzubringen, mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln? Dann stehen dir alle Türen offen und unser Team freut sich über deine Unterstützung.

Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortliche Erstellung von IT-­Anforderungsdefinitionen, IT­-Konzepten und IT-­Security­-Richtlinien und Präsentation der Ergebnisse vor der Geschäftsleitung
  • Verantwortung für die Umsetzung deiner Konzepte sowie Beratung unserer Kunden in Hinblick auf unsere Services
  • Betreuung der Bereiche Server, Storage, Netzwerk und IT-­Security sowie von Projekten im IT­-Admin-­Umfeld
  • Installation und Administration von Microsoft Servern­ und Microsoft/Apple- Clientsysteme (physisch und virtuell) unserer Kunden sowie Analyse und Fehlerbehebung
  • Konzeption und Pflege aller Dienste eines Windows-­Netzwerkes
  • Auswahl, Beschaffung, Installation und Dokumentation der IT-­Systeme gemäß Kundenauftrag
  • KEINE Helpdesk-Tätigkeiten (1st und 2nd Level), dafür haben wir ein zentrales Team

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung bzw. Studium
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Systemadministrator (bestenfalls in einem IT­-Systemhaus)
  • Sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten, auch in Präsentationen gegenüber Kunden
  • Mindestens gute Kenntnisse in der Microsoft 365 Umgebung
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnologien (LAN, WAN, VLAN, VPN)
  • Umfassende Erfahrungen in größeren IT-Umgebungen mit den gängigen Windows Server-und Clientbetriebssystemen
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Virtualisierungstechnologien von Hyper­V (oder VMware/Proxmox)
  • Erfahrungen in veeam Datensicherung und Securepoint oder NetworkBox Firewall Systemen sind von Vorteil
  • Idealerweise Erfahrungen mit alternativen Betriebssystemen (z.B. Linux)
  • Ausgeprägte Service­ und Kundenorientierung
  • Hohe Motivation, Kommunikationsfähigkeit, sicheres Auftreten sowie Teamfähigkeit

Benefits

  • Unbefristeter Vertrag, attraktives Gehaltspaket, Mobile Office oder gerne im Team im modernen Büro
  • Regelmäßige Schulungen und Weiterbildungen sowie die Möglichkeit, dich mit Technikern anderer Standorte auszutauschen
  • Du unterstützt den Standort in Hannover (inkl. der gesamten Metropolregion Hannover-Braunschweig-Göttingen-Wolfsburg) beim Wachstum, kannst mitgestalten und erlangst tiefe Einblicke in das System
  • Neutraler Firmenwagen nach der Probezeit auch zur privaten Nutzung (vorauss. E-Auto oder Hybrid), alternativ E-Bike oder ÖPNV-Ticket
  • Auf Wunsch eine kostenlose Mitgliedschaft in einem Fitnessstudio
  • Gemeinsame Team Events
  • Moderne IT-Ausstattung (Notebook, Smartphone) Mac/Windows mit Mitsprache

Werde Teil unseres Teams als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) in Göttingen, Braunschweig und Hannover! Genieße flexible Weiterbildung, moderne Ansätze und ein engagiertes Team. Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte die IT-Zukunft mit uns!
