title: Chef de projet - Grands comptes cabinets comptables F/H
description_html:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Tu aimes trouver du sens dans ton travail et travailler sur une solution qui pourrait aider des millions d'entrepreneur demain ? Tu t'épanouis dans un environnement sain, dont les bases sont la confiance et l'autonomie ?

Alors peut-être que Pennylane est fait pour toi !

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs et les cabinets d'expertise comptable à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Pourquoi ce rôle est il si important chez nous ?

Le pôle Grands Comptes de Pennylane a été créé en janvier 2022 pour accompagner les 150 plus grands cabinets comptables français dans leur transformation digitale. Depuis, il s'est imposé comme un levier stratégique de croissance : ce sont des milliers de collaborateurs et de clients finaux embarqués sur Pennylane via des déploiement initiaux ou des rachats de cabinets.

Le Chef de Projet est le pilier de cette relation. Il est le premier visage de Pennylane pour nos partenaires stratégiques, celui qui pose les fondations de la confiance et garantit l'excellence opérationnelle à chaque étape. Avec la croissance du nombre de cabinets à accompagner, nous renforçons notre équipe de 6 Chefs de Projet pour continuer à délivrer un niveau d'accompagnement de haut niveau, mais aussi pour contribuer l’évolution nos pratiques de méthodologies de gestion de projet.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En rejoignant l'équipe Key Account, tu prendras en charge un portefeuille de cabinets comptables Grands Comptes à chaque étape de leur relation avec Pennylane : de la réponse à l'appel d'offres jusqu'au déploiement complet de la solution.

Ton impact se mesure à plusieurs niveaux :

  • Pour les cabinets partenaires : tu es le garant d'une expérience de découverte et de déploiement fluide, professionnelle et rassurante, qui transforme des décisionnaires exigeants en ambassadeurs de Pennylane.

  • Pour Pennylane : tu contribues directement à l’acquisition et au déploiement de nos plus grands partenaires, des comptes à fort enjeu stratégique et commercial.

  • Pour l'équipe : tu contribues à faire évoluer nos process pour les rendre encore plus robustes.

MISSIONS

Pilotage de la phase pilote (3 à 6 mois)

  • Organiser et animer les phases de test sur un échantillon représentatif de collaborateurs et de clients finaux du cabinet.

  • Garantir une couverture exhaustive des fonctionnalités Pennylane, en t'appuyant sur les outils d'analyse et la méthodologie de l'équipe, tout en l'adaptant au contexte de chaque cabinet.

  • KPIs : Maîtrise niveau 1 du produit, de la méthodologie et des outils internes. Prise en charge accompagnée de 1-2 comptes à M+3

Orchestration du déploiement (6 à 9 mois)

  • Construire et piloter le planning de déploiement en co-construction avec les intervenants Pennylane et les équipes projet des cabinets.

  • Coordonner les équipes internes Pennylane mobilisées sur le compte : commercial, migration, interopérabilité, consultant fonctionnel, formateurs, produit.

  • KPIs : Autonomie complète sur la gestion d'un portefeuille de comptes à M+8.

Relation et conseil client

  • Être l'interlocuteur de référence des décisionnaires des cabinets (associés, directeurs transformation, directeurs de production comptable).

  • Comprendre leurs enjeux métier, anticiper leurs besoins et proposer des recommandations proactives pour maximiser l'adoption de la solution.

  • KPIs : maîtrise de l’écosystème comptable, concurrentiel et de la réforme de la facturation électronique à M+3. CSAT > 9/10 à M+6

Conduite du changement & suivi de l'adoption

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie d'embarquement adaptée à chaque cabinet depuis la phase pilote jusqu’au déploiement et proposer des plans d'action correctifs le cas échéant

  • Accompagner les collaborateurs comptables dans la prise en main de Pennylane en analyant les indicateurs d'adoption en phase de déploiement et identifier les risques en amont.

  • KPIs : taux d'adoption des collaborateurs des cabinets conforme aux objectifs fixés avec les cabinets en fin de pilote ou déploiement

Contribution à l'amélioration continue

  • Challenger les process et outils de gestion de projet existants, proposer des améliorations concrètes et les déployer en équipe.

  • KPIs : premier retour structuré sur les process et rapport d’étonnement pertinent à M+3

🎯 Ce que l'on recherche ?

Must have

  • 5 à 8 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet complexe, transformation digitale ou conseil (cabinet ou ESN).

  • Expérience avérée de la gestion de projets multi-interlocuteurs à forte dimension stratégique.

  • Excellente capacité à construire et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des profils décisionnaires exigeants.

  • Maîtrise des outils et méthodologies de gestion de projet (planning, gestion des risques, reporting).

  • Sens aigu du conseil : tu sais amener tes interlocuteurs vers la bonne solution avec diplomatie et conviction.

Nice to have

  • Expérience dans le secteur de l'expertise comptable, de l'audit ou de la Fintech/SaaS B2B.

  • Bases comptables ou compréhension des enjeux de la transformation digitale en cabinet d’expertise comptable.

  • Expérience en conduite du changement.

Ce qui fera la différence

  • Un profil qui sait être à la fois rigoureux sur la méthode et agile dans l'exécution.

  • Une vraie envie de construire, d'améliorer et de laisser une empreinte sur les process de l'équipe.

  • Une posture naturellement orientée conseil et accompagnement, pas uniquement delivery.

 

🤝 Process de recrutement

  • Premier échange avec Simon, notre recruteur - 30min

  • Entretien Who avec Aurélie Djoki (Team Lead Project Manager Key Account) - 45min

  • Étude de cas et debriefing avec Arnaud BERNARD (Head of Key Account) et Aurélie - 1h

  • Entretien final avec Tristan LENOIR (Directeur Partner Success) - 45min

🎁 Ce qu'on peut t'offrir ?

💵 Package : Fixe + Variable

🏥 Une mutuelle très complète (Alan Blue)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏢 De supers bureaux en plein centre de Paris (Wework Liège)

🏝 10 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🏃‍♀️Un accès à 8000 salles de sport et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via Gymlib

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Et enfin, l'opportunité de rejoindre une équipe internationale et dynamique : Nous faisons de nombreux sports ensemble (Foot, footing, escalade... etc), nous adorons passer du temps autour d'un verre, et les deux séminaires d'entreprise annuels (Hossegor, Les deux Alpes, Avignon récemment...) sont des grands moments de cohésion.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

title: VP Clinical Development
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Resilience Care
description_html:
🏨 The Company

Resilience is a global, clinical-stage medtech company specializing in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry. We develop digital solutions that transform patient care and generate robust clinical data to improve treatments. As a true sponsor, we are conducting multiple prospective randomized clinical trials to obtain regulatory approvals in Europe and the United States.


📝 Your Role

In a nutshell:

The Vice President, Clinical Development will own and lead all sponsor-led clinical development activities at Resilience across oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry.

This role is accountable for the strategic direction, design, and execution of Resilience-sponsored clinical trials and real-world evidence programs, ensuring consistency, scientific rigor, operational excellence, and regulatory readiness across all business units.

Reporting to the Chief Medical Officer, the VP Clinical Development will build and lead a centralized Clinical Development organization, composed of Clinical Leads and Clinical Scientists, and will serve as the single point of accountability for clinical development execution at the company level.


Key Responsibilities

  • Clinical Development Ownership (Core accountability)

    • Own the end-to-end clinical development strategy and execution for all Resilience-sponsored studies

    • Provide senior clinical leadership on:

      • study design and methodology

      • protocol development and amendments

      • endpoint selection and clinical relevance

      • interpretation of clinical and real-world evidence

    • Ensure alignment and consistency of clinical development approaches across oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry

  • Team Leadership & Organization

    • Build, lead, and mentor a Clinical Development team composed of:

      • Clinical Leads (by therapeutic area)

      • Clinical Scientists

    • Define clear roles, responsibilities, and governance across the team

    • Establish scalable ways of working enabling high-quality, timely execution

  • Portfolio Governance & Standardization

    • Design and implement standardized clinical development frameworks across business units

    • Harmonize:

      • protocol templates and study documentation

      • clinical review and governance processes

      • decision criteria and escalation pathways

    • Ensure alignment with ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, MDR, and applicable regulatory standards

  • Operational Excellence & Inspection Readiness

    • Ensure inspection readiness across all sponsor-led trials

    • Partner closely with Clinical Operations to:

      • drive execution excellence and risk anticipation

      • ensure quality-by-design principles

      • resolve complex operational or scientific issues

    • Act as senior escalation point for clinical development matters

  • Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Collaborate closely with:

    • Regulatory & Quality (clinical strategy, submissions, audits)

      • Biostatistics (study design, endpoints, analysis plans)

      • Medical Affairs (scientific alignment and evidence narratives)

      • Market Access & Public Affairs (clinical evidence support)

      • Product and Data teams (translation of clinical insights into digital solutions)

    • Ensure clinical development is tightly integrated with company-wide priorities

👤 Candidate Profile

🙂 You're the right person if you are:

  • A strategic thinker with the ability to prioritize in complex environments

  • An inspiring leader with a talent for developing your teams

  • Executive presence with strong scientific credibility

  • Cross-functional minded with ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders

  • Comfortable with innovation (digital health, non-traditional endpoints)

  • An excellent communicator and presenter

📃 You're the right person if you have already:

  • An MD MSc or MD PhD degree

  • Minimum 5 years of clinical development experience on the sponsor side (biotech/pharma)

  • Proven experience managing and scaling clinical development teams

  • Strong understanding of regulatory and inspection requirements

  • Worked in international contexts (EU/US regulatory exposure)

Nice to have: Experience in digital therapeutics or biotechs that have obtained CE/FDA approvals.

💛 Why join us?

  • Direct impact on the company's clinical governance: you will build Resilience's clinical engine from scratch

  • Cross-therapeutic exposure: oncology, psychiatry, gastroenterology

  • Strategic interaction with executive leadership: you will work directly with the CMO and CEO

  • Ambitious scale-up environment: combines scientific rigor, digital innovation, and regulatory ambition

3️⃣ Recruitment Process

  1. Strategic Fit - Charles Ferté, CMO (1h) - Assess your clinical vision, governance approach, and leadership philosophy

  2. Cross-functional Assessment - Parallel interviews (30/45 minutes) with:

    • Blanche (Chief of Staff) - Strategic structuring and prioritization

    • Yasmine (Head of QARA) - Compliance mindset

    • Elena (HR) - Leadership and cultural fit

    • Nicoleta (Director Biostat) - (Clinical Scientists) - Technical collaboration

    • Bertille - (Clinical Scientists) - Technical collaboration

    • Elodie - (Clinical Scientists) - Technical collaboration

    • Emma (Clinical Scientists) - Technical collaboration

  3. Case Presentation - Strategic clinical case presentation

  4. Executive Interview (30 minutes) - John, CEO - Vision and strategy alignment

  5. English Test (optional - 5/10 min) - Brief conversation with a native speaker to assess your level

GDPR : Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. They will be available only for people involved in the process and erased after 2 years of inactivity.

Under GDPR and as Resilience attach great importance to privacy, please note that you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased. title: Electrical Engineer (Launcher)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Signal Processing Engineer (RF Processing & Analytics)
description_html:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

Overview

Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.

Ideal candidate

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required

  • PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)

  • Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets

  • Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking

  • Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets

  • Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)

  • Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency

  • DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly

  • Component selection and BOM management

  • Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections.

  • PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints.

  • Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management.

  • Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan.

  • Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes.

  • Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed.

  • EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections.

  • Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up.

  • Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding).

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions.

  • Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at CENTRALE LYON
description_html:
The question

Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply–accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. The quantisation literature for diffusion models reports image-quality scores; the induced L 2 score error, in the form the convergence theory needs, is directly measurable and goes unreported. One open sub-question sets the direction: the distinction between an error redrawn at each evaluation, as in stochastic computing, and an error frozen at write time, as in deterministic quantisation, has been settled in one setting only, and not the one hardware lives in; carrying it over is what this position exists to do. The work is judged on one concrete outcome. For at least one architecture, we want to show that theenergy gain from moving the score evaluation off digital CMOS is real, measured where it survives integration and not extrapolated from a single tile, and that it is paid for by a loss in sample quality that is small and, above all, tunable: a knob the designer sets, whose position the theory predicts rather than discovers afterwards.

What you will do

The work is organised in four packages, summarised below; the full research programme is available from the supervisors on request.

1. Make the score error measurable, starting from Gaussian targets where the whole error decomposition is closed-form. You will report the induced score error for a given perturbation of the network’s arithmetic, the number the theory needs and the quantisation literature does not report.

2. Map device physics onto the theory. Propagate the published error models for the technologies INL works on through the score network into an explicit score-error budget, separating what is proved from what is measured.

3. Extend the guarantees. Existing bounds assume a deterministic oracle, or a benign randomised one; extend them to error that is part frozen at write time and part redrawn at each call, and settle, on the way, which process the score error should be controlled along.

4. Co-design with INL, and deliver the proof of concept. Turn the score-error budget into an energy– accuracy frontier for INL’s PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine, using device-calibrated circuitlevel models; a FeFET-based analog alternative may be considered where appropriate. Jointly vary sampler steps, stochastic bitstream length and effective precision to identify an operating point predicted to yield a real energy advantage over digital CMOS at a small, tunable loss in sample quality. The result is a frontier predicted from mathematical and hardware models, then verified against calibrated measurements.

A clear negative answer is more useful to us than a vague positive one: a negative result on point 3 leaves points 1 and 2 intact and turns point 4 from a prediction into a measurement.


Who we are looking for Required

• A PhD in applied mathematics, statistics, machine learning, electronic engineering, computer science or a closely related field, obtained (or with the defence scheduled) before the start of the contract.

• A strong foundation in probability and stochastic analysis, numerical analysis, optimisation, or machine learning: SDEs, Girsanov’s theorem, time reversal of diffusions, with the ability to apply it rigorously to diffusion or other generative models.

• Familiarity with the convergence theory of sampling algorithms, or the demonstrated capacity to acquire it quickly, for example through Langevin/MCMC analysis, optimal transport or concentration of measure.

• Solid scientific computing (PyTorch or JAX), and the habit of writing code others can run. Ability and motivation to work across mathematical modelling and hardware-aware AI.

• Working English; French is not required.

Valued, not required

Prior work on diffusion or score-based generative models; numerical analysis of finite-precision arithmetic. Familiarity with hardware-aware machine learning, approximate or stochastic computing, analogue in-memory computing, device modelling, circuit simulation, photonics, ferroelectric devices, or energy modelling. Experience linking model accuracy or robustness to implementation non-idealities, such as quantisation, noise, drift, variability, finite precision, or correlated errors. Evidence of interdisciplinary research, for example work at the interface of mathematics, machine learning, devices, circuits, architectures, or electronic-design automation. No hardware experience is expected or needed to apply.

What matters most

We are seeking a researcher who wants to explore how to turn physical constraints into mathematical and architectural design parameters. The project does not require prior laboratory hardware experience: INL provides device expertise, measured characteristics and modelling infrastructure. However, the successful candidate must be prepared to engage critically with non-ideal analog, photonic and ferroelectric accelerators, and to work with both supervisors to connect device-level error mechanisms, score-error guarantees and the energy–quality trade-off of diffusion-model inference. Candidates with a primarily mathematical background and strong curiosity for hardware are welcome, as are candidates from AIhardware, device-modeling, circuit, architecture or EDA backgrounds who have the stochastic-analysis maturity needed to develop the theory. The decisive criterion is the ability to make the mathematics and hardware inform one another, producing predictions that are quantitative, testable and relevant to an energy-efficient accelerator demonstrator.

What we offer

• A real double supervision, with weekly meetings that alternate between ICJ and INL. The two laboratories are on the same campus, five minutes apart on foot.

• A question publishable on both sides: mathematics journals for the theory, design and hardware venues for the co-design.

• Involvement in INL’s design–technology co-optimisation work through the PEPR Électronique CHOOSE project, and contact with the group’s ferroelectric and photonic device work (FVLLMONTI, Ferro4EdgeAI).

• Support for conference travel and open-access publication, funded by the two host laboratories, and the career-development measures the establishment provides for post-doctoral researchers.

• Practical help for international recruits through Espace ULYS, the EURAXESS service centre for Université de Lyon: visas, housing, health cover, banking, schooling.

Conditions

Twelve-month fixed-term contract under French public law, full time (1 607 h annual reference), 25 working days of annual leave plus the RTT days of the establishment’s scheme. Affiliation to the régime général for health and to IRCANTEC for supplementary pension; employer contribution to complementary health cover under the scheme in force at the establishment; 75 % reimbursement of publictransport season tickets, up to the statutory ceiling. The exact number of RTT days is set by the establishment.

title: Senior Incident Responder (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at HvS-Consulting GmbH
description_html:
Wir - die HvS-Consulting GmbH – sind Spezialisten für Cyber Security und davon überzeugt, dass die Werte unserer Gesellschaft auch im Cyber-Raum geschützt werden müssen. Deshalb helfen wir Organisationen, sich mit dem richtigen Zusammenspiel aus Technologien, Prozessen und Menschen selbst zu schützen. Unser Motto lautet „People – Process – Technology"

Für unser Team in Garching bei München suchen wir ab sofort eine(n)

Senior Incident Responder (m/w/d)

Aufgaben

Das erwartet Dich:

  • Incident Response: Du betreust komplexe Cyber Security Incidents bei unseren Kunden und begleitest die First Response, Analyse, Eindämmung, Aufarbeitung und Wiederherstellung
  • Incident-Leitung: Du steuerst Sicherheitsvorfälle, koordinierst alle beteiligten Parteien und sorgst für eine strukturierte, zielorientierte und verlässliche Bearbeitung. Dabei bildest Du die Schnittstelle zwischen den technischen Workstreams und der Entscheider-Ebene, beispielsweise dem Krisenstab oder dem Management. Du kommunizierst sicher mit technischen Ansprechpartnern sowie dem Management und steuerst das Incident Response Team
  • Security Consulting: Du berätst unsere Kunden vor und nach Sicherheitsvorfällen ganzheitlich, um die Strategie, die technische Architektur, Prozesse und Skills des Cyber Defense Centers weiterzuentwickeln
  • Threat Landscape: Gemeinsam mit deinem Team behältst Du die aktuelle Bedrohungslage im Blick. Du informierst unsere Kunden auf technischer und Management-Ebene über relevante Bedrohungen und gibst konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen
  • Technische Schulungen: Du konzipierst und hältst Schulungen, Workshops, Trainings und Übungen rund um Incident Response, Digitaler Forensik und CDC
  • Service Management: Du verantwortest die Qualität und Weiterentwicklung unserer Incident-Response-Services und setzt neue Ideen konsequent um
  • Konzepte und Prozesse: Du entwickelst unsere Incident-Response-Konzepte, Prozesse und Standards kontinuierlich weiter und etablierst praxistaugliche Strukturen

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Führungserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Führungserfahrung mit und hast bereits ein Team fachlich und disziplinarisch geleitet
  • Incident Response: Du verfügst über fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung und Koordination komplexer Cyber Security Incidents
  • Threat Landscape: Du kennst die aktuelle Bedrohungslage und verstehst relevante Threat Actors, Angreifertechniken und Angriffsmuster, beispielsweise bei APT-Angriffen, Ransomware, Innentätern oder Supply-Chain-Angriffen
  • Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Security-Technologien wie SIEM, EDR und NDR
  • Consulting-Erfahrung: Du bist mit der Beratung von Kunden vertraut und vermittelst technische Sachverhalte klar und adressatengerecht und agierst sicher als Schnittstelle zwischen technischen Workstreams, Krisenstab und Management
  • Schulungserfahrung: Du hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Durchführung technischer Schulungen, Workshops oder Übungen
  • Prozesse und Services: Du hast Security-Incident-Management-Prozesse, fachliche Konzepte oder Cyber Security Services entwickelt und erfolgreich weitergeführt
  • KI und Innovation: Du hast Erfahrung in der Integration von KI oder Large Language Models in DFIR-Services oder vergleichbare Tätigkeiten
  • Service Management: Du weißt, wie professionelle Cyber Security Services gesteuert, bewertet und weiterentwickelt werden. Ebenfalls hast Du bereits die potentiale von KI/LLM erkannt und hast diese in Cyber Security Services oder Tätigkeiten integriert
  • Führungspersönlichkeit: Du führst klar und verbindlich, kannst Menschen motivieren und gehst empathisch auf unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten ein
  • Gestaltungswille: Du bringst neue Ideen und strategischen Weitblick ein, übernimmst Verantwortung und setzt Veränderungen konsequent um
  • Qualifikation: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung, sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und rund 20 Prozent Reisebereitschaft (DACH-Raum)

Benefits

Was dich aber vor allem erwartet:

Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Uns gibt dieser Job nicht nur ein Gehalt, sondern auch persönliche Zufriedenheit, weil wir wirklich etwas bewirken und die Welt ein Stück sicherer machen.

Bei uns gibt es (natürlich) kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks, aber das ist heutzutage Standard. Zusätzlich bieten wir auf Wunsch attraktive Benefits, von Jobticket bis hin zu Kindergartenzuschuss. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten helfen Dir, auch auf Unvorhergesehenes im Alltag gelassen zu reagieren. Schau dir unsere Benefits gerne auf unserer Karriereseite genauer an.

Was erwartet Dich noch? Wir pflegen eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur (schau mal auf Kununu) und schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, natürlich auch, aber nicht nur im Home-Office. Schließlich haben wir ein modernes Büro in Garching mit sensationellem Alpenblick, in dem wir gerne gemeinsam Mittagsessen und uns mit unseren Security-Auditoren, Incident-Respondern, Awareness-Trainern und Multimedia-Designern austauschen.

description_html:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

 The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our global Accounting team at Mirakl.
The team operates on a global scope, ensuring the financial integrity of Mirakl's entities worldwide. Together, you'll be supporting accurate, timely financial reporting and contributing to the robustness of Mirakl's finance function as the company continues to scale.

Please note that this mission is a contractor/freelance opportunity and is entitled to 1-day remote work a week 

Your Impact

  • Lead monthly and annual close processes, including managing accounts for foreign subsidiaries and liaising with local accounting firms
  • Own fixed asset control (tangible, intangible, and internally generated assets), including depreciation calculations and reconciliation
  • Ensure payroll accounting accuracy by booking monthly payroll entries in collaboration with the Controlling team and verifying the consistency of payroll and social charges
  • Manage current tax compliance, including VAT declarations (France & international), CVAE, C3S, and DAS2, in coordination with the Tax department
  • Prepare balance sheet justifications, intercompany account reconciliations, and audit-ready files for statutory auditors

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in general accounting
  • Proven track record managing multi-entity and/or international accounting scopes
  • Experience preparing regulatory tax filings and working with external auditors

 

Skills:

  • Strong command of general ledger accounting and month-end close processes
  • Ability to manage intercompany transactions and foreign subsidiary accounts
  • Payroll accounting and social charges compliance
  • Tax compliance (VAT, CVAE, C3S)
  • Rigorous, autonomous, and comfortable working in a fast-scaling environment

 

 Tools Used

  • Oracle Suite (ERP)
  • AI-powered tools (including Dust)

 

 Languages

  • French: Full professional proficiency
  • English: Full professional proficiency

 

Compensation & Contract

This is a freelance / contractor engagement. Rate and terms are open to discussion based on experience and scope.

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

Interview steps:

  1. 30/45-minute call with a TAS to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 45-minute Google Meet business discussion with Manon, our GL Accounting Manager 
  3. 1 x 45-minute STAR interview to assess your alignment with our values and meet another stakeholder you'll be interacting with

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Staff Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Flagstone
description_html:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.


A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.


Does this sound like you?

You're a passionate and experienced Staff Engineer specialising in front-end and mobile, who's excited to forge a new way to save! You set the technical bar for React and React Native across a tribe of squads, drive cross-team initiatives, and act as a force multiplier - coaching engineers, shaping architecture, and representing Flagstone in the wider engineering community.


What you’ll do:

The Staff Engineer will take a leading role in driving front-end and mobile technical strategy across a tribe of 3–5 squads, ensuring the delivery of high-quality systems that meet our business objectives. You'll partner with squads, Engineering Team Leads, and Product to identify how technology can solve business challenges and take a long-term view on company value.

You'll also play a crucial role in mentoring and coaching engineers, helping them grow their system design skills and ship robust, scalable solutions. As a technical leader, you'll provide strategic guidance while also contributing hands-on to key projects. This will focus on:

  • Technical Strategy: Set the front-end and mobile technical vision in collaboration with Engineering Team Leads, aligning with wider business objectives.

  • Cross-Squad Leadership: Originate and lead horizontal engineering initiatives across the tribe; author and shepherd RFCs from proposal to adoption.

  • Solution Delivery: Contribute directly to building and maintaining high-quality React and React Native systems while supporting and unblocking other engineers.

  • Architecture & Design: Own cross-platform architecture decisions for web and mobile (React, React Native, TypeScript), ensuring scalable, reliable, and efficient design with a forward-looking approach.

  • Design Systems: Lead the evolution of our shared design system across web and mobile, driving consistency, accessibility, and developer velocity across squads.

  • Mentorship & Multiplier Impact: Coach engineers in system design, coding standards, and testing; start initiatives that others complete; delegate to protect bandwidth for the highest-leverage work.

  • Communities of Practice: Drive adoption of front-end and mobile engineering practices through CoP leadership and engagement across the tribe.

  • Horizon Scanning: Identify emerging front-end and mobile technologies, build proof-of-concepts, and create roadmaps for adoption.

  • Operational Excellence: Champion the "you build it, you run it" philosophy - driving pipeline observability, zero-downtime deployments, robust monitoring, and alerting for front-end applications.

  • Resilience & Performance: Design solution-wide UI resilience (graceful degradation, back-pressure, retry strategies) and own performance standards across web and mobile.

  • Quality, Security & Compliance: Own threat modelling and security hardening for tribe front-end products; maintain high standards through code review, secure coding practices, and risk management.

  • External Representation: Represent Flagstone externally through conference talks, podcasts, or published content; help attract senior engineering talent through your network and reputation.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers, designers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business needs.

What you’ll bring:

  • Proven experience in a Staff Engineer (or equivalent) role with a front-end and mobile focus.

  • Deep expertise in React and React Native with TypeScript, including cross-platform architecture.

  • Track record of owning and evolving a design system used across web and mobile applications.

  • Strong system architecture and design skills, with thorough understanding of SOLID principles, TDD, DDD, and software design patterns.

  • Experience designing for resilience and performance at scale (graceful degradation, zero-downtime deployments, observability, performance budgets).

  • Experience with Azure development and cloud-based infrastructure, including CI/CD and pipeline observability.

  • Experience owning threat modelling and security hardening for front-end products; strong grasp of OWASP and secure coding practices.

  • Track record of originating and shepherding cross-team initiatives or RFCs to adoption.

  • Excellent coaching, mentoring, and leadership skills - with evidence of being a force multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and strategic thinking.

  • Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills.

  • Comfortable representing Flagstone externally (talks, writing, community engagement) - or keen to start.

  • Agile and Scrum practices experience.

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Around the World scheme - 3 months work from anywhere scheme

  • Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.  

All are welcome.

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

About the squad
The Mobile App squad sits within our Engagement Tribe, whose mission is to deepen how clients engage with Flagstone and grow the balances they hold with us. The native mobile app is an important growth area for us, and we're looking for a product manager to lead the squad through an intensive period of building.


Does this sound like you?

This is a senior product manager role, hands-on role with real ownership. You'll lead the squad, setting the product direction for the mobile app, leading discovery, owning the roadmap, and being the product leader the squad rallies around. You'll report to the Group Product Manager and work closely with both the Group Product Manager and the Tribe Lead on wider tribe strategy, but the direction of the mobile app is yours to shape and deliver.


What you’ll do:

  • Shape the mobile app strategy and roadmap, using customer and market insight, and align it to our tribe and company goals.

  • Lead product discovery: validate problems with data and research, scope solutions, and connect what you build to measurable outcomes.

  • Own delivery end to end for the squad, shipping small and often so we learn quickly and improvements land reliably through the app stores.

  • Provide product leadership to the squad: set the standard for how you work, run retrospectives and experiments, and keep raising the bar on quality.

  • Own the squad's outcomes and metrics, focused on engagement and deposits, and show how the squad's work contributes to wider company goals.

  • Shape stakeholder expectations and secure buy-in across design, engineering, compliance and growth, bringing people with you rather than relying on your title.

  • Analyse in-app journeys from a data perspective to find where they fall short and prove the impact of what you launch.

  • Work with Compliance, content designers, data analysts and go-to-market experts so that what you ship is compliant, well made, evidence-led and ready for clients.


What you’ll bring:

Essential

title: Regional Operator Education Specialist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Neko Health
description_html:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

As Regional Operator Education Specialist you are responsible for the quality and delivery of onboarding for clinical operators across your region, ensuring training maintains a consistently high standard. You support and quality-assure the work carried out by Clinic Trainers, and act as the escalation point for clinical training matters, so that methods, delivery, and assessments stay aligned with global standards.

You also contribute to the maintenance of training programs and content, adapting them for local market needs based on central guidelines and frameworks. This is a competency-based training and safety function.

A note on this role

Medical Education at Neko is growing and its structure is still developing. This is an interim appointment, and the scope described here may change as the wider function takes shape. We will be open with you about any changes as they happen.

What You'll Deliver

Onboarding quality and escalation

  • Ensure clinical operator onboarding is delivered to a high and consistent standard across your region, aligned with central guidelines and member safety requirements.

  • Run the onboarding cycle: confirm incoming starters with Recruitment, allocate trainers, and monitor daily trainee progress, stepping in early where progression is slow.

  • Hold the decision to pass, extend, or offboard a trainee in your region, alongside the Lead Operator team.

  • Act as the regional escalation point for clinical training quality and safety matters, triaging every case on first pass to distinguish a genuine safety risk from a standard performance gap, and seeing it through to closure including structured improvement plans.

Support and coach Clinic Trainers

  • Provide guidance, feedback, and support to Clinic Trainers on training methodology, delivery, and assessment.

  • Hold trainers in your region to one national standard, working with Lead Operators so operational needs are met at the same time.

  • Follow up on trainer performance and development.

  • Support Clinic Trainers in completing Impact Reviews for existing clinical staff in line with Neko’s pillars.

Maintain and adapt training programs

  • Maintain training programs and materials as requested, including Sana content, and adapt them to local market needs while staying aligned with global standards and following approval guidelines.

  • Work from one shared source with your counterpart region rather than maintaining separate regional versions, and flag content gaps and inconsistencies centrally rather than resolving them locally in isolation.

  • Deliver or coordinate key clinical skills training within your region, for example Gen II retrofit training, and provide training-plan input into clinic launches and retrofits.

Monitor training quality and drive improvement

  • Observe training delivery, provide structured feedback, and follow up on what changes as a result.

  • Run regional training audits and benchmarks against the national standard, identifying gaps and putting forward improvement proposals, including corrective action where an audit finding requires it.

  • Oversee trainers’ records of staff competency sign-off. No operator works unsupervised on a new device until sign-off is confirmed.

  • Feed hiring and training trends back to Recruitment so screening improves from what is seen downstream in training.

Partner across the business

  • Work closely with clinic leadership and relevant support functions so training meets operational needs as well as the clinical standard, and act as a regional training voice with Recruitment, clinic leads, and cluster management, syncing regularly to stay aligned nationally.

  • Work closely with Clinical Development, participating in product launch handovers and acting as the educational link for your region, including developing training materials for new devices and SOPs when requested and supporting rollout to trainers and operators on the ground.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Healthcare professional with at least two years of clinical experience.

  • Significant post-registration experience in a fast-paced, high-volume clinical setting.

  • Demonstrated clinical leadership, formal or informal.

  • Existing trainer or competency sign-off experience within a Neko clinic, or equivalent clinical procedure competency such as phlebotomy or ECG.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing clinical teams or trainers, including performance management across multiple sites.

  • Track record in competency-based training and assessment.

  • Experience developing or scaling training frameworks to support clinic expansion.

  • Cross-functional collaboration with Recruitment, Operations, or Education teams.

  • A postgraduate certification in a specialist clinical area or in leadership.

Key competencies

  • Strong communication and a coaching mindset

  • Sound clinical judgement under ambiguity

  • A collaborative approach with operators, clinic leads, and trainers

  • Adaptability to new processes and policies

  • Attention to detail in competency checks and training materials

  • Organisational skills across multiple concurrent onboarding cycles

  • A proactive, problem-solving approach to gaps in knowledge or process

Working conditions

  • This role carries protected training capacity on a fixed weekly structure, with a minimum of one scanning day so you remain clinically current and credible with the operators you train.

  • A minimum trial or shadow period applies before full sign-off authority is confirmed, given the clinical safety responsibilities of the role.

  • This is a hands-on regional role with regular travel across your clinic cluster.

title: Engagement Director - Strategic Accounts
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Legora
description_html:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the Role

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Director to join our growing team and lead Legora's most strategic accounts ( large global law firms and strategic enterprises) as they fundamentally change the way they work with Legora.

This is a role for someone who has led change inside the world's largest, most complex organizations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of a focused set of marquee accounts: building C-suite and executive-sponsor relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted advisor and orchestrator who turns Legora into an embedded part of how the world's most sophisticated legal teams operate.

At the heart of the role is designing each client's adoption playbook and delivering multi-year change-management programs that transform how they work. For every account you will build a tailored roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through firm-wide scaled adoption, oftentimes across a multinational footprint, define measurable outcomes and ROI, and evolve the program as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge.

People management experience is a bonus as you will lead a small team of Engagement Managers and Associates who are dedicated to the success of your clients. In return, you are dedicated to the development of your team.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, setting the bar on our most visible accounts and helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases, and transform the way their teams work.

What You’ll Do

You'll lead the post-sale customer experience, owning onboarding, adoption and long-term value realization for a focused portfolio of Legora's most strategic accounts — Specifically, you will:

  • Design each client's adoption playbook: the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map, and target outcomes for how that organization adopts Legora and transforms the way it works — across practice groups, business units and regions.

  • Execute against that playbook, sequencing initiatives from initial rollout to firm-wide scaled adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.

  • Act as a senior strategic advisor who deeply understands client goals and legal workflows, owns C-suite and executive relationships, surfaces high-impact opportunities, and guides teams toward maximum value from Legora.

  • Lead a small team (consisting of Engagement Managers and Associates) dedicated to your accounts and take responsibility for their development.

  • Drive sustained value through a structured operating cadence: success plans, enablement, stakeholder check-ins, training and executive-level value reviews.

  • Orchestrate engagement from cross-functional teams to accelerate client success (Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Technical Operations, GTM, Marketing), maintaining end-to-end account context and coordination across every region and workstream.

  • Partner with GTM leadership on the most complex commercial moments — high-stakes renewals and multi-year expansions — to ensure seamless handoffs, continuity, and a great customer experience, and to identify and realize expansion opportunities.

  • Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Legal Engineering to shape roadmap, positioning, and enablement for Legora's most strategic segment.

What You Bring

You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You're proactive, strategic and comfortable steering the most demanding executive stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in being the reason the world's most sophisticated legal organizations adopt, grow and succeed.

We're looking for:

  • A consulting or transformation background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering change-management programs inside the world's largest, most complex organizations — Fortune 100, AmLaw 50, or globally strategic enterprises.

  • Experience building tailored, client-level transformation roadmaps and adoption plans at global scale and steering them to measurable outcomes.

  • 10+ years in management consulting, customer success, account management, or a related field, ideally with exposure to high-growth B2B SaaS, AI, or Legal Tech.

  • A track record of owning adoption, retention, and satisfaction with marquee strategic clients and C-level stakeholders.

  • Deep experience working with legal, compliance, or other regulated and complex industries; law firm or legal tech experience a strong plus.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Tech Lead (f/d/m)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at CEEZER
description_html:
A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.

At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

Tasks

Your mission

We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our engineering team. This role requires an ambitious technical leader who can architect scalable systems, navigate complex carbon data architectures, and drive engineering excellence. Moving beyond traditional software delivery, you will translate product vision into reliable technology, lead critical architectural decisions, and leave a lasting mark on our platform from day one.

  • Architect and scale a seamless B2B procurement platform, delivering an intuitive, enterprise-grade user interface designed for daily engagement and complex workflows.
  • Drive end-to-end technical strategy, design, and architecture, translating ambitious product requirements into performant, scalable features and microservices.
  • Lead by example with hands-on technical execution, authoring high-quality, maintainable code across our TypeScript, Node.js, and Next.js stack.
  • Cultivate engineering excellence across the team, providing high-impact mentorship, technical guidance, and rigorous code reviews to continuously elevate development standards.
  • Safeguard platform integrity, establishing robust security, reliability, and performance standards across our applications and core cloud infrastructure.
  • Partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional teams, evaluating trade-offs and technical permutations to engineer optimal, user-centric solutions.

Requirements

What you need to succeed

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of technical leadership (2+ years) guiding teams through complex, full-lifecycle product deliveries.
  • Deep technical proficiency in TypeScript and the Node.js ecosystem, alongside extensive hands-on experience building modern, data-dense interfaces with React or Next.js.
  • Strong architectural expertise in RESTful API design, backend systems architecture, and relational data modelling (PostgreSQL experience preferred).
  • Demonstrated commitment to engineering rigour, with a deep understanding of software design patterns, enterprise web security standards, and modern development workflows (Git, feature branching).
  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure and continuous deployment, including hands-on experience building and maintaining services on platforms like AWS.
  • Exceptional collaborative and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical decisions, bridge alignment across product teams, and mentor engineers.
  • Basic familiarity with Python is a plus, or a strong technical curiosity to expand into auxiliary parts of our data processing stack.

Benefits

What's in it for you at CEEZER?

  • A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.
  • Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.
  • True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.
  • An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.
  • Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.
  • A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.

The hiring process

  • An intro call with the People Team
  • A Technical Interview with our SVP of Tech, Felipe
  • A Case Study with 2 Engineers from the team

Create an impact with us?

We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you.

Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive.

If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

title: Marketing Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Ark Software GmbH
description_html:
What you will work on

Ark builds AI platforms for public administrations. We have entered the marked with our most known tool, a platform for local climate action, about 1 year ago, now working with > 60 cities, counties and states - from Schleswig-Holstein and Berlin to small rural municipalities. We have won the German Startup Award 2026, raised 2.4mn in pre seed and grant money and approach 1mn in annual revenues.

Tasks

About the role

We are currently mainly focussing on outbound leads - but see so many inbound opportunities. From webinars with >100 participants, to clients recommending our tool to an invite to advise the chancellor on AI. Since there are no marketing experts in the team, we are not yet capturing these opportunities. And this is why we are looking for a new colleague 🎉

As always in early stage startups, your role will include adjacent tasks, e.g., PR, social media or branding. You will completely own marketing and work on strategic questions as well as operative initiatives. You will conduct events, own google and linkedin ads, set up our newsletter, and much more. You will not be expected to be an expert in every channel. You should be strong in the fundamentals, curious enough to learn quickly and able to decide what deserves focus.

You come up with the ideas, launch them fast, measure what works and double down. You report directly to Ruth, our founder and CEO.

Your challenge:

  • Own messaging and branding. Decide how we explain what we do and why our target persona should care, and keep that story consistent everywhere.
  • Run campaigns end to end. Scope them, ship them, measure and stop the ones that do not deliver.
  • Open new segments. Build the positioning that lets us grow beyond our current customer base.
  • Measure the funnel. Know where leads come from, what converts, and feed that back to sales and product.

Requirements

What you bring along

Your profile:

We are looking for a marketer who is comfortable starting from a blank page:

  • Marketing experience: around 3-5 years of hands-on B2B marketing experience, ideally in a startup, scale-up or similarly entrepreneurial environment. We care more about what you have built and learned than the exact number of years.
  • Full-stack execution: You are equally happy writing a newsletter, briefing a landing page, setting up an ad account and standing at a booth.
  • Analytical rigour: You know how to evaluate the success of your channels and can tell us the difference between a channel that generates noise and one that generates pipeline.
  • Creativity and messaging instinct: You can generate the material and messages we need for the different channels. The material has to land with our German public sector audience.
  • Language: Excellent German and English (C1). Fluent French, Italian or Spanish is a plus.

Benefits

What you can expect from us

💸 Competitive Compensation Package

We value your skills and expertise - enjoy a salary that reflects your impact.

🚀 Ownership & Growth from Day One

Take on responsibility from the start, tackle exciting challenges, and accelerate your career with a steep learning curve.

🛖 Offices in both German Startup cities

Offices in both, Berlin and Munich. Your home office is Berlin, but you are welcome to work fro the Munich office anytime.

🎉 Team Events & Culture

Join a vibrant team with fun social events, and a culture of open feedback and continuous learning.

💛 Exclusive Perks & Benefits

Stay active with an EGYM Wellpass / Urban Sports Club membership, plus enjoy discounts on top sustainability brands and Bike Leasing.

Admin:

  • Time commitment: Full-time
  • Start date: ASAP
  • Location: Berlin

🤗 We have a few things that matter to us, but we are not looking for a perfect checklist candidate. If you have built things, learned quickly and can show your impact, we would love to hear from you, even if your background does not match every point.

Your team lead will be

  • Ruth (Founder and CEO)

title: PR-Consultant (all genders)

description_html:
Beratung und Content Creation sind Deine Leidenschaft?

Publik ist eine inhabergeführte Agentur in Mannheim mit einem klaren Fokus: Wir machen Kommunikation, die wirkt – strategisch fundiert, kreativ umgesetzt und messbar erfolgreich. Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden kommen aus Technologie, Industrie und Professional Services. Für sie entwickeln wir Strategien, steuern Kampagnen und sorgen dafür, dass aus Sichtbarkeit echte Ergebnisse werden.

Aufgaben

  • Mit Freude und Begeisterung berätst du unsere Kundinnen und Kunden individuell und bist stets daran interessiert, passende Lösungen zu finden.
  • Projekte managst du eigenverantwortlich und zuverlässig – von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
  • Du recherchierst und schreibst Texte für unterschiedliche Content-Formate und Kommunikationskanäle.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Kommunikationswissenschaften absolviert oder kommst als Quereinstieg aus den Geistes- und Naturwissenschaften.
  • Du bringst eine für die Position relevante Berufserfahrung aus dem PR-Bereich mit.
  • Du hast keine Scheu vor komplexen Sachverhalten oder technischen Themen.
  • Du verstehst dein Handwerk und bringst von der Headline über die Longcopy bis hin zu Social-Media-Posts deine Themen stilsicher auf den Punkt.
  • Du setzt moderne KI-Tools sicher und verantwortungsvoll ein, steuerst damit Recherche, Textentwicklung und die Erstellung von Content-Formaten effizient und sicherst die Ergebnisqualität ab.
  • Du bist offen für Neues, lernst gerne dazu und arbeitest selbstständig. Du schätzt ein richtig gutes Team, bringst dich gerne ein und legst Wert auf Qualität.

Benefits

  • Spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben in Voll- oder Teilzeit.
  • Eine vertrauensvolle Agenturatmosphäre und sympathische Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten, Teamveranstaltungen, ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und weitere Benefits.
  • Eine ansprechend gestaltete Agentur im Taylor Green Business Park Mannheim, die ein nachhaltiges Konzept verfolgt und viel Raum zur Erholung und sportlichen Betätigung bietet.

Du fühlst dich angesprochen? Dann freuen wir uns über Deine Bewerbung mit Angabe Deines möglichen Eintrittstermins.

description_html:
Pentadoc sucht erfahrene Business Analyst*innen (w/m/d) aus der deutschen Versicherungsbranche mit Schwerpunkt Operations.

Du hast ein fundiertes Verständnis über Fachprozesse und Versicherungsprodukte und bist umfassend mit typischen technischen Operations-Systemen vertraut. Dieses Wissen benötigst du, um in unseren Kundenprojekten Prozessoptimierungen, Geschäftsanalysen und digitale Transformationsprojekte zu begleiten.

Außerdem gilt es, mit Neugier und Ideenreichtum spannende technologisches Entwicklungen - wie die Anwendung Künstlicher Intelligenz – wertschöpfend in die Praxis zu bringen.

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Etwa 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Business Analyst*in, Product Owner oder Prozessmanager am deutschen Versicherungsmarkt
  • Fundierte Operations-Kenntnisse in der Versicherungs- und Finanzbranche, durch deine Tätigkeit in einem oder mehreren Fachbereichen
  • Du hast ein schnelles Auffassungsvermögen und teilst deine Erkenntnisse pointiert mit anderen
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau

Das sind deine Verantwortungsbereiche

  • Analyse und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen
  • Erhebung und Dokumentation von Anforderungen in Zusammenarbeit mit Fachabteilungen und IT
  • Entwicklung und Implementierung von maßgeschneiderten IT-Strategien und -Lösungen
  • Unterstützung bei der Planung und Steuerung von Transformationsprojekten

Dein neuer Arbeitsalltag

  • Du übst deine Tätigkeit in einem dezentral organisierten Unternehmen aus, das heißt, dein Hauptarbeitsplatz ist zu 80-90% dein Home-Office am Wohnsitz
  • Entsprechend deiner Verantwortung im Projekt sowie dem Projektbedarf angemessen nimmst du eigenverantwortlich auch Vor-Ort-Tätigkeiten wahr.
  • Deinen Arbeitsalltag strukturierst du im Rahmen deiner Aufgaben selbstorganisiert und selbstbestimmt.

Du erhältst

  • Einen aufs Home Office zentrierten Arbeitsalltag
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein Fixum aus 14 Monatsgehältern kombiniert mit einem variablen Gehaltsbestandteil, das an unseren gemeinsamen Gesamterfolg der Pentadoc Gruppe gekoppelt ist.
  • Mobilität: Firmenwagen, Bahncard und auf Wunsch auch ein Firmenfahrrad für deine berufliche und private Nutzung.
  • Hochwertige IT-Ausstattung: Business-Class Ausstattung mit Laptop, Handy, Zubehör und Zuschüssen für deinen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz zuhause
  • Firmenkreditkarte: Eigenständigkeit statt Freigabehölle – Du buchst selbst, was du brauchst, wenn du es brauchst.
  • Betriebliche Gesundheitsmaßnahmen: Du profitierst von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, den Vorteilsprogramm ‚WellPass‘ und Integration von Maßnahmen im Arbeitsalltag

Wir freuen uns über deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung (Gehaltsvorstellung, CV, Projektnachweise) und den anschießenden Austausch mit Dir!
