description_html:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most Product Manager roles are built around specs and handoffs, waiting on a designer's mockup, an engineer's sprint slot, a data analyst's report.

This role is built differently: we're hiring a PM who does more than decide what should be built. You'll steer a developer squad end to end: investigating opportunities, analyzing user behaviour, prototyping solutions with AI, contributing code, launching experiments, and improving what reaches production.

You'll work directly with Pierre Gerbaud, Product Lead, and Michael Monin, our Co-founder & CTO, on a product already used by more than 50 million people and growing toward 100 million users.

At this scale, every small improvement can create significant impact, and you'll have the space to spot these opportunities and act on them quickly.

If your first instinct is to test an idea by making it real, this is your role.

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the work end to end, not just a piece of it: Understand the problem, choose an approach, build the solution (AI-assisted coding, opening pull requests, working with internal tools), launch it, measure it, and iterate with as few handoffs as possible;

  • Build with AI every day: Use AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, and debugging; as a genuine part of how you think and work, evolving with the tools as they improve;

  • Decide what's worth pursuing, and test it fast: When a dozen directions look plausible and there are more ideas than time, identify the opportunities that matter most and design the smallest meaningful experiment to test your assumptions;

  • Let the results determine what happens next: Define success before you build, analyse the outcome once the experiment is live, and use what you learn to improve, expand, or stop what you shipped;

  • Work embedded in a software engineering squad: partner directly with Leads, Co-founders, designers, and engineers to define and deliver priority projects, and communicate progress and decisions to all relevant stakeholders;

  • Keep momentum high: Surface blockers the moment they appear, challenge assumptions directly regardless of who made them, and find another route forward when the obvious one is blocked;

 

Your Qualifications

  • You build with AI: you’ve personally built and shipped a functional feature, experiment, prototype, workflow, or tool using AI coding tools. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools are already part of how you work everyday;

  • You use data to make product decisions: you can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next;

  • You explore AI independently: you actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate directly: you work effectively with designers, engineers, and other stakeholders, ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent in English;

  • You care about the user experience: you take pride in the quality of what reaches users, and pay attention to whether the product is useful, intuitive, and engaging;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have enough design fluency to prompt a usable UI independently

  • You’ve worked at a fast-scaling D2C/consumer tech company or scale-up

  • You have experience on consumer-facing features

  • You have experience in Entertainment, Avatars, Gaming, or any high-touch media industry

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Cursor, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

* 💸 Compensation: Our salary ranges are set based on role level, scope, location, and market data, and applied consistently regardless of candidate background or negotiation history. The final offer within the published range reflects assessed experience and scope.

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

title: Junior Consultant Information Security (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Dataguard
description_html:
YOUR JOB

Do you want to rethink information security consulting with the help of AI? Are you excited to solve complex customer challenges while working smarter, faster, and at scale? Do you enjoy combining hands-on expertise with AI-powered automation to continuously improve how security is delivered? And do you thrive in an environment that encourages efficiency and challenges the status quo? Then join us on our journey.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • You actively shape DataGuard’s growth by managing and expanding the full customer lifecycle for our InfoSec-SaaS product.

  • You advise customers on information security using our platform and build scalable ISMS solutions from scratch.

  • You act as a trusted partner, guiding customers through audits (e.g. ISO 27001 or TISAX®)

  • You leverage AI-powered tooling to deliver faster, more consistent, and higher-quality security consulting outcomes.

  • You support Sales and Customer Success with cross-selling and up-selling opportunities for existing customers.

  • You drive the evolution of our InfoSec solution by translating customer insights into actionable product feedback.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world.

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs.

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market.

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget.

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You have at least 1 year of professional experience in IT, information security, compliance, or have a lead-implementer or auditor certificate

  • You are passionate about technology, security, AI, and how companies can operate safely in a digital world.

  • You have a basic understanding of information security frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC2, TISAX®, NIST or other management frameworks

  • You enjoy working with customers and can explain complex topics in a simple and structured way.

  • You are comfortable using AI tools to work smarter, learn faster and continuously improve how work gets done.

  • You have excellent German and English communication skills

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

*TISAX® is a registered trademark of the ENX Association. DataGuard has no business affiliation with ENX. We solely provide consulting and support services to help prepare for the TISAX® assessment. The ENX Association is not responsible for the content presented on the DataGuard website.

title: Account Executive Team Manager, SME & Growth
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Airwallex
description_html:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

The SME & Growth team at Airwallex partners with ambitious SMB and mid‑market businesses that operate across borders. We help them get paid, hold and convert funds, pay suppliers and issue cards globally – all from a single financial platform.

In DACH, we are in build mode: a lean, high‑calibre commercial team with strong backing, a large greenfield market and high expectations. You’ll join experienced sellers who care about sales excellence, product depth and disciplined execution.

About the role

Reporting into the Head of Sales, SME & Growth, DACH, we are looking for a hands‑on Sales Manager to lead, coach and scale a team of Account Executives focused on SMB customers (typically 20–1000 employees, with average deal size ≥ €2k MRR).

This is a player‑coach role. You will:

  • Own a team quota and be accountable for revenue performance

  • ​​Carry your own sales quota on a small number of opportunities

  • Be deeply involved in live deals – especially complex or strategic ones.

  • Help design and implement the sales operating system for DACH: methodology, cadence, pipeline standards and hiring.

You will be a key operational partner to the Head of Sales and a core contributor to building our DACH go‑to‑market from an early stage.

The role is based in Berlin, in a hybrid working model, minimum 3 days per week in the office.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead, coach and manage a high‑performing team of 4–8 Account Executives serving SMB / mid‑market customers.

  • Run a high‑quality sales operating rhythm:

    • Weekly pipeline and forecast reviews.

    • Regular deal strategy sessions and call reviews.

    • Team enablement on discovery, negotiation, MEDDPICC and closing.

  • Stay close to the field:

    • Join customer meetings and calls.

    • Directly support and co‑own strategic and complex deals with your AEs.

  • Drive sales methodology and funnel discipline:

    • Embed MEDDPICC and SPICED as the standard way of running opportunities.

    • Ensure consistent ICP / persona‑based qualification and messaging across the team.

    • Maintain high standards of CRM hygiene and data quality.

  • Build and scale the team:

    • Attract, hire and onboard A‑players, in partnership with Talent Acquisition.

    • Provide clear expectations, feedback and development paths for each AE.

  • Shape our GTM strategy in DACH:

    • Contribute to our value propositions, pitches and vertical narratives.

    • Partner with Marketing, SDRs and Partnerships on outbound motions and campaigns.

  • Own performance and reporting:

    • Be accountable for quota attainment, pipeline coverage and conversion.

    • Provide regular, data‑driven updates to the Head of Sales on risks, opportunities and resourcing needs.

You are

  • A coach and builder – you genuinely enjoy making people better and building the systems that make a team win.

  • Highly structured and analytical – you can move from problem (“win rate is down”) to root cause and clear action plan.

  • Hands‑on and low‑ego – you are happy to jump on calls, review sequences, build a deck or help close a deal with your AEs.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and 0→1 – you like working where there is no fixed playbook, and you’re excited to help write it.

  • Data‑driven – you use numbers and facts to prioritise, coach and decide, not just gut feeling.

  • Resilient and hard‑working – you like high expectations, high pace and you don’t shy away from doing the work.

Minimum qualifications

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience, including 3+ years as a closing Account Executive on SMB / mid‑market segments.

  • 2+ years in a front‑line sales leadership / team lead role, managing AEs and carrying a team quota.

  • Experience in high‑growth tech or fintech, ideally with:

    • Payments, FX, cards, accounts, or spend management products.

  • Demonstrated experience launching or scaling a new market, region or business line

  • Hands‑on experience building outbound sales motions with SDRs and Marketing

  • Strong, practical command of key Sales Methodology MEDDPICC/SPICED/Challenger

  • Proven ability to coach, develop and performance‑manage Account Executives.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German (native or near‑native) and English (professional).

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Platform QA Chapter Lead (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at JustPlay GmbH
description_html:
Job Description

As Platform QA Chapter Lead on the Platform side at JustPlay, you’ll lead and scale quality assurance for our core app experience — the foundation that powers our games, live operations, and player rewards. Working closely with Engineering, you’ll ensure the platform runs seamlessly across devices, regions, and releases, setting the standard for quality, reliability, and user experience.

You'll split your time between hands-on QA work and leading the QA engineers in the QA chapter: helping them grow in their craft, spreading good practice, and raising the bar for quality across the teams you work with. A key part of this role will be driving smarter, more scalable testing approaches, including AI-driven testing and automation.

 
 

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the full QA lifecycle for JustPlay’s app and platform features — from test planning and execution to reporting and defect management.

  • Foster a strong quality culture across teams by embedding QA best practices early and tying quality goals to product velocity and platform reliability.

  • Drive innovation through AI-driven testing and predictive approaches to identify risks earlier, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort.

  • Partner with development, design, and product teams to integrate QA best practices early in the release cycle.

  • Design and maintain comprehensive test plans and automated suites for key user flows (login, payments, live events, notifications, etc.).

  • Lead, mentor, and scale the QA team — setting up clear processes, code quality standards, and testing frameworks.

  • Implement automation and regression testing strategies using tools such as Maestro, Espresso, XCTest, Appium, or similar frameworks.

  • Use contract testing (e.g., Pact) to validate backend and service integrations.

  • Apply performance and reliability testing across mobile platforms to ensure smooth user experiences.

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in QA for mobile apps or platforms, including at least 2 years leading teams.

  • Proven ability to design scalable QA processes in fast-paced, development-heavy environments.

  • Strong experience with automation frameworks, regression testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with mobile debugging tools (Android Studio, Xcode) and network analysis tools like Charles.

  • Strong understanding of how to build a quality-first mindset across engineering and product teams.

  • Interest in or experience with AI-assisted testing and new QA technologies.

  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-first mindset.

  • Familiarity with project and documentation tools such as Jira and Notion.

Nice to have

  • Experience in backend integration testing and API monitoring.

  • Experience with contract testing frameworks such as Pact.

Job Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner nilo.health to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

 

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

title: Layout Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Black Semiconductor GmbH
description_html:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

We are looking for a Layout Engineer to join our design team and support the development of layouts for photonic integrated circuits. You will maintain our layout infrastructure, help translate new designs into fabrication-ready layouts, and contribute to the implementation of new design rules and verification flows.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Maintain and further develop our layout libraries and workflows in Synopsys

  • Support designers in generating layouts for new photonic devices and circuits

  • Run design rule checks (DRC) and layout-versus-schematic checks (LVS)

  • Investigate and resolve DRC violations, off-grid errors, and other layout issues

  • Implement new design rules

  • Assemble layouts

  • Support the mask flow from device layout through to mask data preparation

Your Qualifications

  • Degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Photonics, or a related technical field

  • Strong Python programming skills

  • Understanding of integrated-circuit design; knowledge of photonic integrated circuits is good to have

  • Experience with photonic or electronic layout software, ideally Synopsys OptoCompiler

  • Experience with physical verification tools, ideally Synopsys IC Validator or a comparable platform

  • Experience using KLayout

  • Familiarity with DRC, LVS and mask-data preparation

     

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

 

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect!

If your application results in an employment relationship, your Applicant Data will be transferred to our personnel records and processed in accordance with applicable legal requirements; otherwise, your Applicant Data will be retained for up to six (6) months after completion of the recruitment process. Read more about our privacy policy here.

description_html:
Ralph ist Deutschlands modernste Hausverwaltung. Wir denken WEG von Grund auf neu – mit 10.000 Einheiten deutschlandweit haben wir bewiesen, dass unser Modell skaliert. Wir verbinden unsere eigene AI-Software mit der Expertise erfahrener Profis und einem starken operativen Team, das dir den Rücken frei hält.

Deine Rolle: Strategischer Fokus statt Admin-Chaos

Du arbeitest bei uns strategischer als in klassischen Verwaltungen. Du bist der/die souveräne Ansprechpartner:in für Beiräte, während unsere Struktur dir den administrativen Wahnsinn abnimmt:

  • Support: Ein Customer Success Team beantwortet Tickets und Standard-Anfragen für dich.

  • Technik: Ein Instandhaltungs-Team übernimmt die Handwerker-Koordination.

  • Backoffice: Ein Buchhaltungs-Team hält die Zahlen und Abrechnungen sauber.

  • AI: Unsere Software automatisiert die Dokumentation und das Daily Business.

Deine Mission

  • Beirats-Management: Du pflegst die Beziehungen zu den Beiräten und führst deine Gemeinschaften souverän durch das Jahr.

  • Versammlungsleitung: Du moderierst hybride und digitale Eigentümerversammlungen mit unserer hauseigenen Software.

  • Innovation: Du bist die Schnittstelle zum Produkt-Team und hilfst uns, die Software so zu bauen, dass sie Verwaltern das Leben rettet.

  • Wachstum (Optional): Du hast Lust, neue Kunden zu begeistern? Wir honorieren das mit attraktiven Prämien.

title: Founder's Associate
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Norman AI GmbH
description_html:
Norman is building an AI accountant that helps small businesses manage invoicing, accounting, and taxes. We’re a small team based in Berlin.

As Founder's Associate, you’ll work directly with the founders across the full customer loop. You’ll talk to customers in German, help them get into the product, support them when they’re stuck, and help them decide whether to buy—honestly, not with a hard sell. Beyond that, you’ll take on business development, product feedback, and ops work that keeps Norman moving. This is a broad early-stage role across customer success, support, BD, product, and ops.

Full-time, remote within Germany.

Tasks

  • Take inbound calls and chats with people who found Norman and want to know if it fits their business.
  • Run demos and guided walkthroughs in German, tailored to their workflow. Help people onboard: setup, first tasks, and day-to-day product questions.
  • Identify product gaps and opportunities for improvement from these conversations. Help get them to production.
  • Own the purchase conversation: clarify fit, handle objections, and help suitable customers decide and get started. No sales quota or commission today—judgment and follow-through matter more than pressure.
  • Support current users when they’re stuck or considering next steps (customer support + success).
  • Help with business development: partnerships, outbound experiments, and turning strong conversations into pipeline where it makes sense.
  • Use Norman every day, catch friction early, and feed clear examples back into product.
  • Work with founders on product priorities: document recurring questions, objections, and workflow gaps; help turn them into better onboarding, help content, and product decisions.
  • Take on ops work that keeps a small company running smoothly (process, tools, follow-ups, light project ownership).
  • Help with webinars, short product videos, or a small community as we grow education around Norman.

Requirements

  • Native-level German (spoken and written) for confident, natural customer conversations.
  • Willingness to wear many hats in an early-stage startup—CS, support, BD, product feedback, and ops in the same week.
  • Strong listening: ask useful questions, explain software patiently, and avoid jargon.
  • You learn products and processes fast and care why people (and systems) get stuck.
  • You stay organized and follow through across calls, tickets, BD threads, and internal ops.
  • Based in Germany.

Nice to have:

  • SaaS/fintech experience or experience with tools for Freiberufler and small businesses.
  • Familiarity with invoicing, bookkeeping, or German tax workflows (no Steuerberater required).
  • CRM experience; you’ve done demos, support, partnerships, or light ops/project work before.
  • Interest in teaching in public (webinars, short videos, community).

Benefits

  • Work remotely within Germany.
  • Direct work with founders in a small team—high ownership, real impact.
  • Broad mandate across customers, product, and the company—not a siloed role.
  • Your feedback and work show up quickly in how Norman grows.

Interested? Send your CV or LinkedIn plus a short note covering your customer-facing (or early-startup) experience, why this role, and one example of helping someone get unstuck—a customer, a process, or a product.

title: Product Engineer (m/w/d) - remote oder Karlsruhe
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Knuddels GmbH & Co. KG
description_html:
Wir bei Knuddels wollen soziale Netzwerke wieder wirklich sozial machen – weg vom Konsumieren von Content, hin zu echter menschlicher Nähe. Unser Ziel: Bei Knuddels soll jeder Mensch drei wichtige Menschen für sein echtes Leben finden.

Als Product Engineer verbindest du Produktmanagement, Design, Softwareentwicklung und Qualitätssicherung. Du begleitest Features von der Idee bis zur Weiterentwicklung nach dem Launch. Dabei übernimmst du eigenständig Verantwortung und bekommst fachliche Unterstützung aus dem Team.

So arbeiten wir

Wir arbeiten in kleinen Teams aus zwei bis vier Personen und kurzen Zyklen: Eine erste, sinnvoll nutzbare Version geht live, wir lernen aus Nutzerfeedback und entwickeln sie weiter.

Aktuell wachsen Teammitglieder aus spezialisierten Rollen in die Rolle als Product Engineer hinein. Du hast bereits Erfahrung mit dieser Arbeitsweise und gestaltest den Wandel mit. Unser Knuddels Operating System bündelt dafür Design System, Tooling, Wissen und KI-gestützte Test-Tools und wird gemeinsam weiterentwickelt.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Verstehen und priorisieren: Du leitest aus Daten und direktem Community-Feedback ab, welche Probleme du innerhalb unseres strategischen Rahmens als Nächstes angehst.

  • Gestalten und entwickeln: Du übersetzt Nutzerprobleme in durchdachte Feature-Konzepte: Ziele, Funktionsweise und Umfang definierst du ebenso wie UX/UI. Du setzt deine Lösungen technisch um und integrierst sie in unsere bestehende Codebasis. Dabei nutzt du KI-Tools gezielt und kannst den entstehenden Code verstehen, beurteilen und weiterentwickeln.

  • Qualität sichern: Du sicherst die Qualität deiner Features mit automatisierten und teilautomatisierten Test-Tools und holst dir bei Bedarf fachliche Unterstützung.

  • Veröffentlichen und verbessern: Du bringst nutzbare Versionen live, beobachtest ihre Wirkung und entwickelst sie technisch und funktional weiter.

  • Zusammenarbeiten und Wissen teilen: Du stimmst dich mit deinem Team, der Geschäftsführung und relevanten Stakeholdern ab und dokumentierst Entscheidungen und Learnings.


Was bieten wir dir?

  • Bau mit uns die Zukunft der Produktentwicklung: Bei uns bekommst du den Freiraum, Neues auszuprobieren und deine Features eigenverantwortlich von der Idee bis zum Release zu bringen. Kurze Entscheidungswege und KI im gesamten Entwicklungsprozess machen es möglich. Unser Knuddels Operating System liefert dir die Werkzeuge dafür.

  • Flexibilität, die sich Deinem Leben anpasst: Bis zu 100% Remote Work, Vertrauensarbeitszeit, 10 unbezahlte "Flexi-Urlaubstage" zusätzlich zu 30 Tagen Urlaub.

  • Echter Zusammenhalt: Eine offene, respektvolle und kooperative Kultur.

  • Wachstum nach Deinen Vorstellungen: 10% deiner Arbeitszeit für Weiterbildung, Coaching-Pool, Inhouse-Workshops, regelmäßiges Feedback.

  • Fokus auf unser eigenes Produkt (B2C): Du siehst unmittelbar, wie dein Beitrag bei unserer Community ankommt.

  • Exzellente Ausstattung: Hervorragendes technisches Equipment, bei vollständig remote Arbeit zusätzlich ein Zuschuss zum mobilen Klimagerät.

  • Büro in Top-Lage (Karlsruhe): Kostenloses Frühstücksbuffet, täglich frisch gekochtes Mittagessen, voll klimatisiert, riesige Dachterrasse.

  • Gesundheit: Zuschuss zum Fitnessstudio/Sportverein.

  • alle Benefits findest auch nochmal unter jobs.knuddels.de

Was bieten wir nicht?

  • Staubige Konzernstrukturen

  • Arbeiten an Geschäftskundenprojekten (Wir sind ein B2C-Unternehmen)

  • Einen an den Haaren herbeigezogenen dritten Bullet Point, wenn uns nur zwei einfallen :)


  • Erfahrung: Du hast Features bereits über Produktmanagement, Design, eigene Softwareentwicklung und QA hinweg verantwortet. Du musst nicht überall gleich stark sein; entscheidend ist praktische Erfahrung über alle vier Bereiche.

  • Technik und KI: Du beherrschst mindestens eine moderne Programmiersprache, hast Web-Anwendungen bzw. APIs gebaut und betrieben und nutzt KI-gestützte Coding-Tools im Alltag. Java, Spring Boot, Svelte, React und TypeScript sind ein Plus.

  • Produkt und UX: Du verstehst Nutzerprobleme, entwickelst gut bedienbare Lösungen und begründest Entscheidungen mit Feedback und Daten.

  • Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eigenständig, holst dir gezielt Unterstützung und kommunizierst Entscheidungen und Zielkonflikte klar dem Team gegenüber.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse.

title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Kotlin/Java/ AWS (m|w|d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at idealo internet GmbH
description_html:
Als Teil unseres Clickout-to-Revenue Teams arbeitest du am Kern unseres Geschäftsmodells: Händler zahlen für qualifizierte Weiterleitungen („Clickouts“) zu ihren Shops. Deine Arbeit stellt sicher, dass diese Monetarisierung technisch sauber, performant und transparent funktioniert – und damit maßgeblich zu idealos Wachstum beiträgt. 

 

Deine Aufgaben  

End-to-End-Verantwortung  

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst Business- und Web-Applikationen in der AWS Cloud.  

  • Gemeinsam mit deinem Team verantwortest du die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette (YBYO): Architektur, Infrastruktur, Entwicklung, Testing, Security, Deployment, Monitoring, On-Call und Wartung.  

 Produktfokus: Monetarisierungsprozesse und -Services  

  • Du entwickelst Services für die Darstellung und Abrechnung unserer Geschäftsmodelle. Zentrale Komponenten hierfür sind das EPR-System Odoo, interne Tools für die Stammdaten-Verwaltung sowie Schnittstellen zu Salesforce und SAP.  

  • Innovative Geschäftsmodelle, brauchen innovative Lösungen - aus diesem Grund stehst du in engem Austausch mit Stakeholdern wie unserer Buchhaltung, Sales-Team, Account-Management und weiteren, cross-funktionalen Engineering-Teams. 

Technische Exzellenz  

  • Du bringst aktiv Ideen zur Prozessverbesserung ein, legst Wert auf hohe Codequalität und entwickelst dich kontinuierlich weiter – Wir unterstützen dich dabei mit verschiedenen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.  


Das bringst du mit

Must-haves  

  • 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Web-Applikationen, davon mind. 5 Jahre mit Kotlin/Java.  

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in AWS-Architektur und Infrastructure-as-Code (z.B. Terraform). 

  • Fundiertes Wissen in relationalen Datenbanken (z.B. PostgreSQL, MySQL) und Event-Messaging, Event-Streaming und asynchroner Kommunikation (z.B. Aiven Kafka).

  • Du denkst in End-to-End-Verantwortung und kannst technische Konzepte klar kommunizieren – auch an Nicht-Techniker:innen. 

  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team, teilst dein Wissen, gibst konstruktives Feedback und bringst dich aktiv in Pair-Programming, Code-Reviews und gemeinsame Lösungsfindung ein.  

Nice-to-have 

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.

  • Erfahrung im ERP-, Buchhaltungs- oder Finance-Umfeld.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Click out to Revenue (m|w|d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at idealo internet GmbH
description_html:
As a Senior Software Engineer in our Clickout-to-Revenue team, you’ll work on one of idealo’s most business-critical domains: the systems and processes that turn millions of clickouts into reliable merchant billing and revenue.

This is a role with significant technical ownership. You’ll shape the architecture and evolution of our monetization landscape, make technical decisions across services and integrations, and help solve complex challenges at the intersection of engineering, finance, and commercial processes.

Beyond building and operating software, we’re looking for someone who can bring technical direction, challenge existing solutions, and raise the engineering bar within the team.

About your new role

  • You take technical ownership of business-critical services and applications that connect clickouts, merchant billing, and revenue processes across idealo.

  • You shape the architecture and technical evolution of this domain, balancing scalability, reliability, maintainability, and business needs.

  • You design, build, and operate applications in AWS and take end-to-end responsibility following our “You Build It, You Own It” approach – including architecture, infrastructure, development, testing, security, deployment, monitoring, and on-call.

  • You drive technical improvements and help identify where existing systems, integrations, and processes need to evolve.

  • You design and evolve integrations across our monetization landscape, including Odoo, internal master-data systems, Salesforce, and SAP.

  • You act as a senior technical sparring partner within the team, contributing to architectural discussions, challenging solutions, and helping others make sound engineering decisions.

  • You work closely with Accounting, Sales, Account Management, and other engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into sustainable technical solutions.

  • You contribute to strong engineering practices through pragmatic technical standards, code reviews, pair programming, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.


Skills & Requirements

Must-haves

  • You have extensive experience designing and building complex backend or web applications with Kotlin and/or Java and have taken technical ownership beyond individual features.

  • You have a strong track record of shaping architecture and driving technical decisions in complex production environments.

  • You have deep experience with AWS and Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform) and are comfortable owning systems throughout their full lifecycle.

  • You have strong knowledge of relational databases and distributed, event-driven systems, including event messaging, streaming, and asynchronous communication.

  • You can navigate complex technical and business dependencies, identify pragmatic solutions, and communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You raise the engineering bar around you through technical guidance, constructive challenge, knowledge sharing, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with ERP systems or accounting- and finance-related domains.

  • Experience building AWS Lambda functions for data-processing use cases using Python or TypeScript.

  • German language skills.

At idealo you can expect

  • You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget.

  • And what about the office? Our office in the heart of Berlin offers free organic breakfast, excellent free lunch (vegan and vegetarian), as well as free coffee, lemonades and after-work beer, in addition to the "standard foosball". It also has a fabulous rooftop terrace with view of the whole of berlin where you can network with colleagues from our group of companies.

  • In need of additional support in any areas of your life? We offer free counseling and support in all areas of life (professional, private, family, health, etc.) in cooperation with the pme-Familienservice.

  • You want full flexibility on your way to work and beyond? No problem with a job bike or Deutschlandticket - and it's environmentally friendly, too!

  • Want to keep yourself fit? We offer many different fitness and sports options, such as an Urban Sports or Gympass membership, to suit your personal needs.

  • And what else is there? Of course, success must be celebrated! In addition to team events, you can also expect big company events and other moments of organized connection with others in the company and your team throughout the year!

description_html:
Who We Are

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the (Senior) Web Analyst (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. 


What Will Your Role Be

We're looking for a Senior Web Analyst to own and evolve our digital measurement ecosystem.
You'll help us understand how millions of users interact with our digital products and turn that understanding into better product and business decisions.You'll work at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Engineering, ensuring that our tracking is accurate, scalable and future-proof. From defining measurement strategies to implementing tracking solutions and uncovering actionable insights, you'll play a key role in improving our digital products and customer experience.

This is not a generic Data Analytics or Data Science role. We're looking for someone with a strong background in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics who enjoys solving real business problems through reliable data.

What You´ll Do 

  • Own Digital Measurement

    • Own and continuously improve our digital measurement landscape across multiple digital products.

    • Design, implement and optimise client-side and server-side tracking solutions.

    • Ensure accurate, scalable and privacy-compliant data collection.

    Drive Measurement Strategy

    • Translate business questions into measurement concepts and technical tracking requirements.

    • Define KPIs and success metrics together with Product, Marketing and business stakeholders.

    • Develop tracking specifications for new products, features and customer journeys.

    Generate Insights

    • Analyse user behaviour, customer journeys and conversion funnels.

    • Build dashboards and reporting solutions that enable data-informed decision making.

    • Identify optimisation opportunities and provide actionable recommendations.

    Experiment and Optimise

    • Design, implement and evaluate A/B tests and experimentation initiatives.

    • Measure the impact of new features, campaigns and product improvements.

    • Continuously improve tracking quality, measurement standards and analytics processes.

    Collaborate Across Teams

    • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and Marketing teams.

    • Present analytical findings in a clear and actionable way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Help establish analytics best practices across the organisation.

What You´ll Bring

  • Several years of experience in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics.

  • Hands-on experience with modern tracking implementations and digital measurement architectures.

  • Practical experience with tag management systems such as Adobe Experience Platform Tags or Google Tag Manager.

  • Experience with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4 or comparable enterprise analytics platforms.

  • Solid knowledge of JavaScript and experience with SQL and/or Python.

  • Experience with client-side and server-side tracking.

  • Strong analytical thinking combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.

  • A solid understanding of data quality, tracking validation and analytics governance.

  • Confidence working independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Product Analytics platforms.

  • Experience with Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau.

  • Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake or similar cloud data environments.

  • Experience with experimentation platforms.

  • Knowledge of privacy regulations and consent management.

  • Experience in e-commerce or digital consumer products.

Why Should You Join Us

 

  • Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business.

  • Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so.

  • We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another.

  • Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company.

  • Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change.

  • The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We value diversity at Spread Group. We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital or disability status.

Who We Are

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Software Engineer Backend (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. The position is initially a fixed-term position to cover parental leave.

What Will Your Role Be

You'll join Design Experience — the team behind the tools people use to turn an idea into something they can actually wear. We own the creation experience across our brands: the Create-omat design editor, AI-assisted design generation, template and text handling, embroidery, and the design services behind them. Our mission is to let anyone move from idea to product with the market's leading creation tools, and every order on our platform starts with a design that was made on one of our surfaces.

We are a small, senior team in Leipzig and Berlin with a product owner, a tech lead and a handful of engineers, which means the person who designs a service is usually the person who ships and runs it. Our stack spans two worlds: Create-omat is a Next.js application in TypeScript that currently also carries its own backend-for-frontend, while the surrounding services run on the JVM with Spring against MySQL, MongoDB and S3. The AI side runs on OpenAI and fal.ai models with Langfuse for tracing and cost control, and everything ships through GitLab CI onto Kubernetes.

This is a fixed-term position covering a parental leave. It is not a placeholder role: the backend work waiting for you is the part of our roadmap that decides what the next two years of our architecture look like.

What You´ll Do 

  • Pull business logic out of the Create-omat BFF and into services other  frontends can actually use — today the design editor owns logic, data and storage all at once, and that is the single biggest constraint on the team

  • Build our design generation backend: moderation, image generation, design enhancement and background removal as a pipeline that Create-omat, the Partner Area and our upcoming co-creation agent all call, instead of each building their own

  • Replace splitbrain, the Spring service that serves the Partner Area with a near-duplicate of that same functionality — two systems, one capability, and your job is to make it one

  • Design and build the system-layer APIs behind our data — Scene, Template and Design — so that MongoDB and S3 stop being something every consumer reaches into directly, and take part in the cross-team API discussions where those contracts get agreed

  • Modernize designer-service-api, a Java service with real consumers in two other teams: raise test coverage, retire vulnerable dependencies, and coordinate every contract change with the teams that depend on it

  • Own services in production — observability, alerting, on-call-quality logging, and the performance questions that come with rendering and image pipelines

  • Work with a product owner, designers and frontend engineers in an agile team, and connect what you build to whether people finish a design and put it in  their basket

What You´ll Bring

  • Several years of professional backend experience with services you carried from design to production and then operated

  • Solid JVM skills — Java or Kotlin with Spring — including data modelling, migrations and the parts of a service that only hurt once traffic is real

  • Working proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript, enough to be productive inside a Next.js backend-for-frontend from the first weeks — a large share of the logic you will move lives there

  • REST API design as a craft: you think about the consumer of a response, you version deliberately, and you know what a breaking change costs other teams

  • Confidence with both relational and document databases — MySQL and MongoDB in our case — plus object storage, and a clear sense of what belongs where

  • A grasp of what it takes to run a service: containers, CI pipelines, metrics, structured logs and traces

  • Self-direction. The role starts in the middle of an ongoing initiative rather than at the beginning of one, so you need to be able to read an existing system, ask the right people the right questions, and turn an under-specified topic into something you can ship in slices

  • Testing as a habit and a working relationship with code review

  • Good communication skills in English

Why Should You Join Us

 

  • Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business.

  • Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so.

  • We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another.

  • Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company.

  • Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change.

  • The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at homie
description_html:
Über homie – Dein zukünftiger Arbeitgeber mit Zukunft

homie ist ein stark wachsendes deutsches KI Startup mit langfristig gesicherter Finanzierung. Unser Homie ist ein KI-basierter Assistent, der in Echtzeit berät und so für zufriedene Kunden und mehr Umsatz sorgt. Wir sind ganz vorne mit dabei, wenn es darum geht KI-Systeme der Zukunft zu gestalten. Unsere Mission: Mit smarter, evolutionärer KI und echtem Praxisnutzen die Beratung und den Verkauf auf ein neues Level heben.

Aufgaben

**Deine Rolle – werde unser Wachstums-Architekt!

**Als Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die strategische Verantwortung für unser gesamtes Paid- und Performance-Marketing. Du bist unser Architekt und Treiber für planbares, skalierbares Neukundengeschäft – und die Person, die aus Marketingbudget verlässlich Pipeline und Umsatz macht. Datenbasiert, effizient und mit klarem Blick auf die Wachstumsziele des Unternehmens.

Dabei leistest du echte Pionierarbeit: Als unser erster Performance Marketing Manager baust du diesen Bereich von Grund auf – als Stratege und Umsetzer in einer Person. Es geht nicht um Teamführung, sondern darum, mit eigenen Händen ein starkes Fundament zu legen. Ein Teamaufbau ist für später geplant, und du gestaltest ihn mit.

Du verantwortest die Paid-Strategie entlang des gesamten Funnels – von Awareness über Consideration bis hin zur Conversion – und übersetzt Umsatz- und Pipeline-Ziele in konkrete Budgets, Kanalstrategien und Forecasts. Performance-Marketing verstehst du dabei nicht als isolierte Disziplin, sondern als integralen Bestandteil unserer Revenue-Strategie in enger Verzahnung mit Sales und Customer Success.

Du setzt die Prioritäten: Du identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale, verantwortest die Test-Roadmap, erschließt neue Kanäle und Märkte und baust Kampagnenstrukturen, die auch bei deutlich steigenden Budgets effizient skalieren. KPIs wie CPL, CAC, Payback, Conversion Rate und Pipeline-Impact sind für dich nicht nur Reporting-Zahlen, sondern die Grundlage für Steuerung und Planung.

Gleichzeitig bringst du strategische Weitsicht und Kommunikationsstärke mit: Du etablierst ein belastbares Tracking- und Attributions-Setup, machst Performance für alle Beteiligten transparent und nutzt moderne KI-Tools sowie Automatisierungen, um Effizienz und Performance stetig zu steigern.

Im Mittelpunkt steht: qualitative Leads, transparente Performance-Strukturen und nachhaltiges Wachstum für ein ambitioniertes KI-Startup.

Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung Marketing & Sales.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Performance-Strategie & Ownership: Verantwortung für die datenbasierte Paid-Strategie entlang des gesamten B2B-Funnels (Awareness bis Conversion) – abgeleitet aus den Umsatz- und Pipeline-Zielen des Unternehmens
  • Budgetverantwortung & Forecasting: Planung, Allokation und Skalierung sechs- bis siebenstelliger Werbebudgets auf Basis von CPL, CAC, ROAS, Payback und Customer Lifetime Value – inklusive belastbarer Forecasts für die Geschäftsführung
  • Full-Funnel Campaign Ownership: Eigenverantwortliche Planung, Umsetzung und Skalierung kanalübergreifender Kampagnen (z. B. Google, LinkedIn, Meta) mit klarem Fokus auf Pipeline-Impact – strategisch und hands-on
  • Wachstum & Skalierung: Identifikation neuer Wachstumshebel, Zielgruppen, Kanäle und Märkte sowie Aufbau und Priorisierung einer systematischen Test- und Experimentier-Roadmap
  • Marketing-Sales-Alignment: Gemeinsam mit Sales Verantwortung für Ideal Customer Profiles (ICP), Lead-Scoring-Modelle, SLAs und Feedback-Loops zur kontinuierlichen Qualitätssteigerung
  • Lead- & Pipeline-Optimierung: Generierung qualifizierter B2B-Leads mit Fokus auf SQL-Qualität, Conversion entlang der Pipeline und nachhaltigem Revenue-Impact
  • Tracking & Attribution: Verantwortung für ein sauberes, skalierbares Tracking-Setup (z. B. GA, Tag Manager, CRM-Integration, Offline-Conversions) sowie Weiterentwicklung der Attributions- und Messlogik
  • Conversion-Rate-Optimierung: Analyse und Optimierung von Landingpages, Funnels, Creatives und Messaging auf Basis datengetriebener Insights und A/B-Tests
  • Reporting & Management-Sparring: Aufbau transparenter Performance-Reports und Dashboards mit klaren Handlungsempfehlungen – du bist Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung bei Go-to-Market- und Wachstumsentscheidungen
  • AI & Automatisierung: Strategischer Einsatz moderner KI-Tools und Marketing-Automationen zur Effizienzsteigerung, Skalierung und datenbasierten Entscheidungsfindung
  • Pionierarbeit & Strukturaufbau: Aufbau des Performance-Bereichs von Grund auf sowie Definition interner Standards, Prozesse und Best Practices – als Fundament für den später geplanten Teamaufbau

Qualifikation

**Dein Profil – Das bringst Du mit
**

  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance-Marketing und davon mehrere Jahre die Verantwortung für einen skalierenden Paid-Bereich getragen – idealerweise im B2B-, SaaS- oder Tech-Umfeld
  • Du kannst messbare Erfolge vorweisen, z. B. signifikante Senkung des CAC, Skalierung von Budgets bei stabilem ROAS oder Aufbau einer planbaren, wachsenden Pipeline
  • Du denkst in Revenue, nicht in Reichweite. Pipeline-Impact, SQL-Qualität, Payback und Customer Lifetime Value sind für dich die relevanten Steuerungsgrößen
  • Du hast echte Budgetverantwortung getragen und Kampagnen von validierten Tests auf sechs- bis siebenstellige Jahresbudgets skaliert
  • Du hast Lust auf Pionierarbeit. Als erster Performance Marketing Manager bei uns denkst du strategisch und packst gleichzeitig selbst mit an
  • Du baust skalierbare Performance-Strukturen, nicht nur einzelne Kampagnen – saubere Setups, klare KPI-Logik, nachhaltige Skalierungsmechanismen
  • Tracking ist für dich kein Nice-to-have, sondern Fundament. Du hast Attributionsmodelle, CRM-Integrationen und datengetriebene Entscheidungsmodelle selbst aufgebaut und weiterentwickelt
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten – schnell und pragmatisch. 80/20 ist für dich ein Werkzeug, kein Risiko
  • Testing ist Teil deiner DNA. Du validierst Hypothesen strukturiert, testest aggressiv und priorisierst konsequent nach Impact
  • Du liebst Growth Hacks und probierst gern Neues aus – dabei bleibst du immer zahlenorientiert und arbeitest gern mit strukturierten Reportings, die zeigen, was wirklich funktioniert
  • Du verbindest Kreativität mit Performance-Denken. Starke Creatives und klare Messaging-Logik gehören für dich zusammen
  • Du nutzt KI und Automatisierung proaktiv, um Effizienz, Skalierbarkeit und Wettbewerbsvorteile zu schaffen
  • Du arbeitest unternehmerisch. Du wartest nicht auf perfekte Rahmenbedingungen, sondern schaffst sie. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, setzt selbst die Prioritäten und willst mit hoher Ergebnisorientierung aktiv gestalten
  • Du bist kommunikationsstark. Du erklärst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich, kommunizierst klar, fordernd und lösungsorientiert und vertrittst deine Empfehlungen souverän gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Produkt und Sales
  • Du willst Impact. Nicht nur ein Kampagnenmanagement aufbauen, sondern einen messbaren Beitrag zum Unternehmenswachstum leisten
  • Du bist ein Teamplayer. Ambitioniertes Mindset und Kollegialität schließen sich für dich nicht aus, sondern gehören zusammen

Benefits

  • Remote oder Hybrid: Arbeite flexibel von überall oder in unseren Office-Spaces in Hamburg oder Köln
  • Startup-Spirit: Schnelle Entscheidungen, flache Hierarchien, agile Arbeitsweise und viel Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Learning Culture: Strukturiertes Onboarding, offene Feedback-Kultur & echter Austausch auf Augenhöhe mit der Geschäftsführung
  • Teamwork first: Du arbeitest eng und auf Augenhöhe mit Sales, Customer Success und Produkt zusammen. Kollegiale & persönliche Atmosphäre, regelmäßige Teamevents und Knowledge Sharing Sessions
  • Lösungsorientierte Kultur: Wir fördern Kreativität, Eigenverantwortung und den Willen, Dinge voranzutreiben
  • KI-Boost: Du nutzt modernste Tools – von KI-Outreach bis hin zu Automatisierungen, die deine Arbeit smarter und zukunftssicher machen
  • Keep going smarter: Budget für Weiterbildung, Konferenzen und E-Learnings, um immer auf dem neuesten Stand der KI-Entwicklung zu bleiben
  • Your benefits: Mit einem monatlichen Zuschuss unterstützen wir dich bei Mobilität, Fitness, Lebensmitteln oder sonstigem

Warum diese Rolle perfekt für Dich ist

  • Du bekommst echten Wachstumseinfluss. Deine Entscheidungen wirken direkt auf Pipeline, Umsatz und Skalierung. Klare Ziele, viel Freiheit in der Umsetzung und volle Verantwortung für Budget und Ergebnis.
  • Du leistest Pionierarbeit. Als erster Performance Marketing Manager baust du den Bereich von Grund auf – kein starres Konzernkonstrukt, sondern die Chance, ein skalierbares Growth-Setup zu prägen und den später geplanten Teamaufbau mitzugestalten.
  • Du arbeitest im Zukunftsmarkt KI. Performance-Marketing für ein innovatives KI-Produkt bedeutet hohe Relevanz, klare Differenzierung und echtes Marktpotenzial.
  • Du bist strategischer Sparringspartner fürs Management. Deine Insights beeinflussen Go-to-Market-Strategien und Wachstumsentscheidungen auf GF-Ebene.

Ready to become our Growth Architect?

Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

description_html:
Die steigenden Energiekosten treffen jeden Haushalt. Wir senken, was gerade am meisten wehtut.

Enter ist die Antwort auf eine Frage, die sich gerade Millionen Hausbesitzer stellen: Nicht ob ihr Haus elektrifiziert wird – sondern wie, und mit wem. Bei steigenden Energiekosten helfen wir Haushalten durch die Installation der richtigen Wärmepumpen und PV-Anlagen jährlich um die 1.500€ einzusparen.

Als Deutschlands führender Energieberater mit über 40 Millionen Euro Funding und über 90 Mitarbeitern sind wir erfahrene Pioniere in einem Markt, der gerade erst so richtig losgeht.

Enter. Jetzt ist der Moment.


Die Fakten.

  • Start: 15.10.

  • Gehalt: €40.000-50.000 brutto pro Jahr

  • Arbeitsort: Büro an der Spree (Schlesische Str. 26, 10997 Berlin)

  • Homeoffice Möglichkeiten

  • Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/w) und flexible Arbeitszeiten (spätester Beginn um 9:30 Uhr)

  • Benefits: Learning-Budget, Urban Sports Clubs, Jobticket- oder Kita-Zuschuss; Betriebliche Altersvorsorge; Team-Events, die nicht langweilig werden


Was Du machen wirst.

Du gestaltest mit unserem People Lead das Wachstum unseres Sales Teams.

  • End-to-End Recruiting mit Fokus auf Sales-Positionen (Pre-Sales & Sales Manager, unterstützend für weitere Rollen)
  • Active Sourcing als Kernaufgabe: gezielte Direktansprache über LinkedIn Recruiter & weitere Kanäle
  • Screening von Bewerbungen und Führen von Erstgesprächen
  • Aufbau und Pflege eines warmen Talentpools
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Hiring Managern im Sales-Team
  • Erstellung und laufende Optimierung von Stellenausschreibungen
  • Mitwirkung an Recruiting-Kampagnen (Multi-Channel-Postings, Social Media)

title: Senior Account Manager (m/w/d)

description_html:
Einleitung

Du willst nicht einfach nur Kunden verwalten, sondern ein eigenes Portfolio strategischer B2B-Kunden von Grund auf skalieren? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir stellen unseren B2B-Bereich gerade neu auf – und Du kommst als eine:r der ersten Senior Account Manager:innen an Bord. In dieser Rolle prägst Du von Tag eins an mit, wie diese Funktion bei Peter Park funktioniert, und übernimmst echte kommerzielle Verantwortung: Du sicherst wiederkehrende Umsätze über hohe Kundenbindung, treibst die Standort-Expansion voran und verkaufst zusätzliche Services an bestehenden Standorten. Du berichtest direkt an den Team Lead Account Management.


Was ist Deine Aufgabe?

  • End-to-End Portfolio Ownership: Du verantwortest ein eigenes Portfolio unserer strategisch wichtigsten Kunden von A bis Z. Mit klaren Accountplänen behältst Du die Relevanz und die Decision-Maker je Kunde immer fest im Blick.

  • Proaktive Expansionsstrategie: Gemeinsam mit dem Sales-Team entwickelst Du für jeden Account eine maßgeschneiderte Expansionsstrategie – von der Standortanalyse über den Business Case bis zur gezielten Ansprache.

  • Upselling an Bestandsstandorten: Du erkennst Potenziale an bestehenden Standorten frühzeitig und wandelst Signale eigenständig in unterschriebene Vertragsnachträge um.

  • Strategische Business Reviews: Du führst regelmäßige Reviews mit Deinen Kunden durch, analysierst Entwicklungen und behältst die Performance Deines gesamten Portfolios vorausschauend im Griff.

  • Erste Ansprechperson mit Lösungsstärke: Kommerziell wie operativ bist Du die zentrale Vertrauensperson für Deine Kunden. Bei komplexen technischen Themen oder Kapazitätsfragen holst Du gezielt Customer Success mit an Board.

  • Datenbasiertes Account Management: Du steuerst Deine Accounts über harte KPIs (Umsatzentwicklung, NPS, CSAT, Health Score) und handelst proaktiv, bevor aus einem Risiko eine Kündigung entsteht.

  • Zentrale Schnittstelle & Escalation Level: Du agierst als Bindeglied zwischen Tech, Product, Operations und Vertrieb und bist die letzte interne Eskalationsstufe, bevor die Führungsebene übernimmt.

  • Mentorship & Teamentwicklung: Du gibst Dein Wissen aktiv weiter und unterstützt als Mentor:in die Entwicklung unserer Junior- und Mid-Level-Kolleg:innen.


Was Du mitbringen solltest:

  • Erfahrung: 5+ Jahre B2B Account Management mit einem nachweisbar starken Track Record.

  • Kommerzielles Handwerk: Du beherrschst Preislogiken, Vertragsverhandlungen und Business Cases auf Basis fester Kundendaten statt Bauchgefühl. Du verbindest Kundenbedürfnisse mit unseren Business-Zielen – inklusive einem begründeten "Nein", wenn nötig.

  • Ownership & Haltung: Du übernimmst volle Verantwortung für Deine Kunden und kommunizierst Zielabweichungen direkt mit einem konkreten Lösungsvorschlag.

  • Datenfokus: Diszipliniertes Arbeiten im CRM (HubSpot ist ein Plus) gehört für Dich dazu. Du liest Health Scores und Standortdaten mühelos und leitest daraus klare Actions ab.

  • Übersetzer-Kompetenz: Du denkst Dich schnell in unsere Produkt- und Systemwelt ein und übersetzt komplexe technische Setups so, dass nicht-technische Entscheider:innen leicht Ja sagen können.

  • Resilienz & Priorisierung: In harten kommerziellen Gesprächen bleibst Du souverän und priorisierst Deine Aufgaben konsequent nach Impact und Wert.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher (C1+). Weitere Sprachen von Vorteil


Work Setup:

  • Arbeitsmodell: 40 Std./Woche (Vertrauensarbeitszeit) mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten

  • München Hybrid: 3 Tage Office in der Neuen Balan / 2 Tage remote, plus regelmäßige Vor-Ort-Termine bei Deinen Kunden im DACH-Raum

  • Vertrag & Vergütung: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, attraktives Fixgehalt plus leistungsbasierter Bonus

  • Perspektive: Klare Entwicklungspfade – wahlweise als Fachkraft (Expert) oder Führungskraft (Team Lead)

  • Team: Ein ambitioniertes Team aus aktuell 5 Kolleg:innen


Welche Vorteile bietet mir Peter Park?

So ticken wir! Passt das zu Dir?

  • Own & Prioritize: „Nicht mein Job“ gibt's bei uns nicht. Du übernimmst und ziehst durch.

  • Think Big: Wir denken in Portfolios, nicht in Einzeldeals.

  • Bias for Action: Wir entscheiden schnell und justieren im Gehen nach.

  • Have Backbone, Disagree & Commit: Du sagst früh, was Du denkst und ziehst mit, wenn entschieden ist.

Deine Vorteile

  • Vertrauensbasiertes, flexibles Arbeiten im Office mit Alpenblick in der neuen Balan oder remote.

  • Start-up-Flair trotz Wachstumstempo: kurze Wege, Duz-Kultur vom Werksstudent bis zum CEO.

  • Attraktives Fixgehalt plus leistungsbasierter Bonus.

  • Eigenverantwortung, Feedback-Kultur, steile Lernkurve und die Chance, eine ganze Enterprise-Motion von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

  • 29 Urlaubstage, Team-Events, IT-Ausstattung Deiner Wahl, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Urban Sports Club, Essenszuschuss, wöchentlicher Team-Lunch.

  • EU-Workation: Du kannst auch mal von einem anderen EU-Land aus arbeiten.


Klingt nach Dir? Schick uns Deine Bewerbung an ----- Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

description_html:
About the role

Gauss Fusion is looking for a creative and hands-on Working Student to support its communications activities at our headquarters in Garching bei München.
 
The role will have a particular focus on visual and digital communications, helping to turn complex scientific, engineering and corporate information into clear and engaging communications materials.
 
You will support the development of social and digital content, visual assets and other branded materials, while also contributing to German-language communications, media and industry monitoring, and the practical coordination of communications activity.
 
You will work closely with the person leading/supporting Gauss Fusion’s communications activity and with colleagues across the company to gather information and turn it into effective communications outputs.
 
This is an execution-focused role offering practical experience within a fast-moving scientific and industrial environment.


Main responsibilities

  • Create and adapt visual assets for social and digital communications, including graphics and other supporting content.
  • Support the visual presentation of complex scientific, technical and corporate information in a clear and accessible way.
  • Assist with the production and coordination of social media content, particularly for LinkedIn.
  • Help maintain communications and content plans, gather inputs from colleagues and support the timely preparation of planned content.
  • Provide practical creative support for branded materials and visual communications within the Garching office environment.
  • Support the preparation and adaptation of German-language communications, including translation between English and German where required.
  • Monitor relevant media coverage, industry developments and competitor activity and help compile concise updates for internal stakeholders.
  • Provide other practical and execution-focused communications support as required.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree programme in Communication, Journalism, Marketing, or a comparable discipline.
  • Fluent or native-level German, with strong written and spoken English.
  • Strong visual and digital capabilities, with an ability to present information clearly and effectively.
  • Good understanding of contemporary social and digital communications channels.
  • Ability to understand complex information and translate it into accessible visual or written communications outputs.


Competences and preferred skills

Competence

  • Creative mindset combined with strong attention to detail.
  • Structured, organised and reliable working style.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned tasks.
  • Comfortable managing multiple activities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and confidence gathering information from colleagues across different functions.
  • Curious and willing to learn about complex scientific, engineering and industrial topics.
  • Sound judgement about how information should be presented for different audiences and formats.

 

Preferred Skills

  • Previous experience creating visual or digital communications content through university projects, internships, employment or comparable activities.
  • Familiarity with commonly used graphic design, presentation and digital content-creation tools.
  • Experience supporting or managing content for LinkedIn or other contemporary digital channels.
  • Some experience of information design, particularly presenting complex material in a simple and visually effective way.
  • Experience translating or adapting communications content between German and English.
  • Interest in science, engineering, energy, technology or other complex industrial sectors.

title: Senior Online-Redakteur / Content Consultant (All Genders)
